title: (Trump) Manager
description_html:
You can take/copy the powers of any Parahuman you touch, as well as give the powers you have taken/copied to others. You have fifteen slots to store powers and can have five of them active at a time. You can temporarily go over this limit, but you will suffer Thinker headaches that worsen rapidly the longer you are over your maximum limit.

Negentropy increases your active limit by 2 and your total slots by 5.

You can alter the powers in your possession by cycling through different expressions of the same power, modifying them by boosting one aspect at the expense of another or changing their restrictions. Multiple compatible powers can occupy the same slot and synergize together. Power compatibility depends on the power itself, not its expression.

This power works on Cauldron Vials and the Garden of Eden; you will get a random expression when getting those powers.

You can discard unwanted powers, but you will not be able to acquire them again unless you steal/copy them again. Copying powers can take a minute, but stealing them happens instantly.

addons.title: Self Guided Coding
addons.description_html:
Power Guru can be used on powers stored inside (Trump) Manager, allowing you to grow your copied/stolen abilities over time, as well as on (Trump) Manager itself. Moreover, it treats each power individually with its cooldowns.

Power Guru can also be used once a month to generate a single power up to 15 SP held inside Manager.

addons.title: Supervisor Override
addons.description_html:
Manager’s ability to copy abilities is expanded upon, allowing you to utilize the information and data from (Thinker) Vision as a vector for replication.

This allows you to replicate the abilities of anyone and anything capable of being seen in your vision. This also includes anything it could envision as an ability in itself. If it can be seen in a Vision, it can be replicated.

This is done by feeding the information from your (Thinker) Vision to your (Trump) Manager and allowing it to construct its copies as it normally would when encountering powers.

addons.title: Garden Seed
addons.description_html:
You may now plant a power seed into a slot for (Trump) Manager, allowing it to grow there in place of a normal target.

Planting a power seed inside (Trump) Manager removes your ability to recall it; instead, it’ll simply be treated as an ability that was acquired by (Trump) Manager.

addons.title: Administrative Assistant
addons.description_html:
You can now direct Manager to replicate any of your own abilities to hold in its slots as you would the abilities of others.

In addition to the potential outcome of having multiple copies of your own abilities, as well as being able to manipulate them and their expression, this effectively allows you the ability to give out copies of your abilities to others. 

This also extends your power to manipulating your existing abilities, whether inside (Trump) Manager slots or not, allowing you to freely alter their expressions.  

You may also use this to replicate the abilities you gain in some manner from any of your other abilities, for example a power via (Trump) Paramount, to copy, manipulate, and distribute.

title: (Trump) Oberon
description_html: You can gain a permanent copy of the power of any Parahuman you touch. This works on the substance in Cauldron Vials and the Garden of Eden, though adapted for human use. You can only have five of these powers active at a time, but rather than the Fairy Queen's ghosts, you have these powers for yourself. Negentropy increases your active limit by two.

addons.title: Elfame
addons.description_html:
Oberon and Fairy Queen merge gaining each others functions, you can now use any of the powers of any of your shades for yourself and you can now summon shades for any power you possess, replicated, stole, or otherwise acquired. This includes any of your own. 

Shades no longer need to look like their sources, and you can freely shape them as you wish, no longer beholden to looking like caricatures or even human-like and may reshape them into something new whenever you wish. You can summon the same ability and/or shade as many times as you want, as long as you have enough slots. 

Your slots are combined, capable of allocating them to summon a shade or any ability for yourself, and you can swap them at any time.

title: (Trump) Prototype
description_html:
You have 18 slots to store powers. You can only have 6 active at once, but you can instantly switch which ones are active. You can instantly empty a slot, but it takes 30 seconds to load a power pattern from memory.

Each day, you gain 10 charges (up to a maximum of 200 stored). You can use these charges to copy, create, and improve powers. You can use 1 charge to copy the power of a parahuman in your line of sight within 100m of you. You can use from 1 to 5 charges to create a new power; the created power will be random unless you constrain it. (1 charge would be around 3 on the PRT scale, 5 charges would be around 7). The more precisely you constrain a power, the weaker it will be.

You can expend more charges to tweak or improve the created powers further to your liking. The strongest power you can create would be equivalent to a Tier 3, weaker than Prototype. To prevent an overload, the number of active slots will reduce if you have powers stronger than Tier 2 active, down to only two if you slot the strongest power you can make. The only power you cannot reproduce is Eidolon, as your power already fulfills that function (that is, to select and interface with powers).

You have two secondary Thinker powers. One that allows you to perfectly recall power patterns, and one that allows you to understand the patterns, modify and combine them into new powers.

Negentropy increases your daily charges to 15 and your slots to 24.

addons.title: Alpha Testing
addons.description_html:
Your ability to create powers has been enhanced by Ignis Fatuus’s ability to hold multiple powers in one slot. Now you have the ability to create powers that are meant to be held in more than one slot, allowing you to spend more charges on them proportional to their slots (2 slots can be up to 10, 3 slots can be up to 15, etc.).

Additionally, you can flicker and page through different states of your stored power, allowing you to recover spent charges on created or copied powers. However, doing so would make it as if you never had the power, meaning that you would be unable to recall the power pattern.

title: (Blaster/Striker) Sting
description_html: You can infuse anything you can touch, any projectile you fire, or any power you manifest, with the ability to ignore select laws of physics, including the ability to pass through anything. These will not pass through your own body unless you will them to. You cannot empower yourself with this. Along with this ability, you also have an intuitive understanding of angles, trajectories, as well as an enhanced sense of timing.

addons.title: Breacher
addons.description_html:
Your layered forcefields now attain Sting’s abilities, being applied to be Striker and Brute-based as anything coming in contact with your forcefield is disintegrated and disseminated through turning Sting on its head in conjunction with Destruction Barbie’s method of durability, shunting the impact back to another dimension; Sting, then, shifts both the impact and energy to adjacent dimensions across the Multiverse, “corroding” a material’s structural integrity as your volatile forcefield continuously shunts its atoms to other alternate timelines or dimensions.

If the force bypasses said defense, don't worry—every layer of your forcefields is incredibly tough, comparable to the crystalline folding layers of Endbringers.

And if the force is sufficiently powerful to ‘shatter’ a layer (or you willingly ‘shatter’ it yourself), it unloads a burst of Sting’s multidimensional energy to expand and destroy anything in a wide berth around your barrier.

addons.title: Longinus
addons.description_html:
Your All-or-Nothing Blaster powers helped remove Sting’s touch-based limit, creating a multitude of results depending on the power responsible.

Stilling’s wave manipulation can now manipulate everything within your radius’s laws of physics, stilling and agitating motion to physical force, spreading Sting’s All-or-Nothing effect in the area, creating both a prison and a trap for dimensional entities. As a blast, it spreads Stilling to all foreseeable realities, which comes close to physical nonexistence in Worm.

Scrub’s spatial shunting stops pretending to be a Blaster, becoming a precise spatial phenomenon where Sting helps in ignoring a target area’s defenses and counterattacks with Scrub clinically shunting molecules to other neighboring dimensions.

Damsel of Distress becomes a raging phantom Blaster power, a pinpoint warping of spacetime that silently bypasses and erases physics instantly hitting its mark, then creates a singularity of unstable dimensional whirlwind, annihilating or irreparably warping every version of the area with explosive release. This leaves its resulting trajectory with an area where the laws of physics are thin and recovering, reality’s fabric frayed at the seams.

But generally, regardless of how you achieve this, you’re able to imbue the 300m² of your surroundings with energy, selectively loosening physics’s hold within it, circumventing or manipulating physics after a fashion. This also infuses the area with a multidimensional All-or-Nothing effect capable of affecting Entities or phenomena that possess dimensional anomalies, a final Longinus.

title: (Tinker) Revolution
description_html: You have access to every Tinker technology tree as well as understood technology dating back to the dawn of civilization(s). The closer to understood technology your inventions are, the less black-boxed they are. This limit can be raised if you study and analyze your own technology or if a technology you created is reverse-engineered and understood by scientists. You can have 3 method specializations (modular, efficiency, etc), 5 broad specializations (lasers, waves, code, vehicles, etc.), and 9 narrow specializations (clockwork automata, personal equipment, prosthetics, surveillance, etc.) at once. It takes a minute to switch between specializations. Note: Even if you build a replicator, the created items will still be black-boxed and need maintenance. Note: Technology levels, your base technology level is based at least on 2010 technology and cannot be lower if you are in a world with a more primitive understanding.

addons.title: [Breakthrough]
addons.description_html:
Despite your Shard teeming with technological endeavors that defy comprehension and open new frontiers of scientific insight, its primary function seemed to be aiding in the discovery of unexplored knowledge that forms the innovative bedrock of science, being the [Cycle]'s field-tester of technologies and host species’ scientific achievements. Still, as it’s the nature of innovation, it doesn’t stray far from its origin, being innately limited by its foundations. This is no more, as Clarketech’s inclusion broke those hurdles.

Synergizing with Clarketech, it accelerates the power’s research development by leaps and bounds, backed by Clarktech’s Cycle-breakers, now white-boxed to expose the science of it all, turning into a savant in study. Analyzing Clarketech’s extremes and the potential it could attain as a basis, there’ll be no “ceiling” a tech tree can have while maintaining a full understanding of it; to transgress gravity as a fundamental force in one of your projects, an extraordinary grasp on how it works in the first place is essential, wouldn’t you agree?

As a result, this rapid understanding halves Revolution’s research time, e.g., taking a month to fully understand and utilize a narrow specialization at its full potential and how to tap into it in unfathomable ways. This, as previously said, opens the chance for white-boxed Clarketech for wider use, without Tinkertech’s weaknesses. Surely, other host species have discovered near-perfect methods for material preservation, haven’t they?

addons.title: Revelation
addons.description_html:
Your Thinker slots merge with your Tinker slots, massively enhancing the power and versatility of the Thinker powers you are capable of manifesting; specifically, your narrow slots can hold thinker powers up to a PRT threat rating of five, broad slots can hold Thinker powers up to a seven PRT rating, and last but not the least, your methodology slots can hold Thinker powers up to a threat rating of nine.

As your slots merge, they can only hold either a Thinker power, a Tinker power, or a power combining both ratings. In the latter case, it will be limited to a Thinker power enhancing or elevating the Tinker specialty in some way or form. This also reduces the rating of the power by one, so what would otherwise be a Thinker rating of nine would become a Tinker/Thinker eight. This does not weaken pure Tinker powers in any way.

Additionally, you no longer lose accuracy when Thinker powers do not operate using your own senses.

addons.title: Omnium est Scientia
addons.description_html:
Through the fusion of the Engine of Escalation and Revolution, your shard has mutated into something greater than just a vast catalogue of the technological databases that the Entities have collected. This fusion allows (Tinker) Revolution to access a vast database of technology beyond the universes the entities have managed to access, collecting detailed information to catalogue into shards. 

Initially, the maximum strength of this new technological database will grant only three slots, equivalent to a lesser Keystone, or a single technological database, equivalent to a Greater Keystone. Gradually, this will expand in scope. Moreover, the number of power slots will gradually increase, further enhancing your versatility.

Furthermore, this database will continuously scan for new information, dithering and generating new data, giving you access to new tinker specialisations beyond specialisations entities have already given out as shards. Constantly evolving your catalogue, ensuring that it constantly adapts, refines, and refashions itself to meet your ever-changing needs and challenges.

Should you have [Breakthrough], you will be able to improve upon shardless technology, creating far stronger technology than the base database would normally allow, as if the “ceiling” of any technological database you possess has lifted. You would also be able to switch between shardless slots far faster.

title: (Thinker) Neural Network
description_html:
You have access to a network of 512 Nodes (768 with Negentropy) that can be used for several purposes. For every 16 unallocated nodes, your thinking speed is increased by 25% additively.

Nodes can be used to store approximately 2.5 PB (petabytes) of information, which includes memories. One Node is sufficient to store a perfect snapshot of your brain.

Nodes can also be grouped into a Module. This allows them to be programmed to perform various functions like keeping track of time, automatically creating a backup of your brain, processing your vision to parse any text and store it in a node, and more. If it can be done with a computer, it can be done with a module. One node has roughly the same processing power as a high-end server.

You can also use Nodes to create a Cluster, which allows them to host Thinker powers. The power uses several nodes equivalent to the square of its rating (Thinker 2 takes 4 Nodes, Thinker 3 takes 9 Nodes, and so on). Your maximum rating is 9. The powers can only use information gathered from your own senses,  including any power-granted senses.

title: (Trump/Tinker) Shards
description_html:
You are a Tinker specialized in manipulating Shards, which allows for personal Shard editing/refining/researching and [Data] gain from nearby Shards.

[Data] gathering takes active combat with a Shardbearer to process and copy [Data], allowing your Shard to gain these powers or offshoots. You can cannibalize different [Data] to strengthen or weaken different powers, adjusting them with your Raw [Data] and [Resources].

You gain both passive Raw [Data] Acclimation, which accelerates depending on how much [Data] you have in your Shard (you can code and edit sweeping changes, on a much larger scale, with a more effective ability creation and incorporation, with a speedier pace depending on your [Data]’s quantity and variety you’ve copied from other Shards) and a passive [Energy] gain from, both from researching energy-efficient (energy-rich) methods and passively editing your Shard to implement this improvements, which will increase your Shard's life span if left unused.

At the same time, your Shard can be overtaxed if intensively utilized until it breaks in terms of raw [Energy] usage, though you will be warned. Having Negentropy will mitigate this risk, based by adding better methods of [Energy] usage, production, and allocation.

If offered direct access to inert Shards e.g. The Garden of Eden, you’ll freely manipulate these Shards with a touch, interfacing with them, plus a significant [Energy] expenditure, discover the methods of Shard Construction, and make powers from them, this analysis taking 72 hours of direct contact (with Negentropy or Shardless making this moot, bypassing this condition).

Shard Construction’s (by extension Power Creation’s) requirements will take up an incredible amount of Raw [Data] and [Energy] to assemble, configure, set up, and finally fine-tune up to your task, enough you take the serious risk of immediate Shard Death due to how [Data] and [Energy]-intensive it is (Negentropy neutralizes this risk, though). The Raw [Data] necessary for Shard Construction is about a year's worth of [Data] generation (equal to 20 fully [Data] replicated Shards worth for a full year as well left unused), with the Raw [Data] needed for Power Configuration being variable based on the Shard’s resulting specialization in question.

title: (Shaker/Blaster) Stilling
description_html:
You now have the ability to wield the power known as Stilling, an incredible power that allows you to negate and manipulate wavelengths.

Its versatility is immense, as it can be used for disintegrating molecular bonds, canceling heat and sound, slowing or stopping motion, and negating the effects of virtually any superhuman ability/power. It can even be used to heal and much more.

This power manifests as golden light, which you can shape into any form you wish. All of your "Stilling" effects are completely silent, can range greatly in power (from pencil-thin cutting beams to planet-destroying blasts), and have practically infinite range. Your light can even track and home in on targets, even curving in mid-air.

You are capable of manifesting a golden aura that grants you the ability to fly at immense speeds. Thanks to the aura itself, you can fly even through space and other hostile environments without any problems.

You can use your Stilling ability to "tune" your defenses to negate any power, even if they are far more powerful than you. You also have an automatic adaptive defense that makes you immune to anything used against you.

You can use the Stilling ability to its fullest potential even without knowing exactly how it works.

addons.title: Agitation
addons.description_html:
To turn the Entities’ main weaponry into a multi-tool of the physical world isn’t difficult, what’s necessary is a medium to accurately defy the uncertain principle of particles, while Stilling easily dabbles in particles—their wavelength-matter duality opens the way for Stilling’s many capabilities—it doesn’t come far from its true potential when it comes to its scope and true implications.

The Ultimate Question is the key; being the Entities’ near-perfect answer for limited resources, they played around with energy’s infinite variations, needing a thorough awareness of a particle’s accurate position and momentum to achieve its capabilities, especially at zero-point. Using [Simulation] and [Manipulation] to accurately pinpoint wavelengths’ frequencies allows Stilling to control the energy present in particles. This shortens the time you’d take to accomplish this with only Stilling.

This manifests in your light taking a more uniform and indiscriminate, almost blinding, gleam, with all that it touches having your characteristic sheen, where you control all their physical phenomena except truly changing them to another state completely; manipulating their interaction with fundamental forces, their systemic energy, and the particle they’re composed of, is fair game, regardless.

The Ultimate Question’s Thinker aspect now covers the energy presence within the particle to locate them accurately and lock in with Stilling.

addons.title: Perfect Tuning
addons.description_html: While manipulating sound and vibrations of your area is good, it doesn’t even scratch the surface of its real ability: working through the maxim of Relativity “everything is energy”, the frequency at which it vibrates dictates its form and properties, that is to say, the wave that which it carries and transmits energy to one point to another. Using Stilling to pinpoint said waves within particles comprising reality, Sound of Silence supports it by allowing it to expand its reach to vibrational wavelengths, manipulating vibrations and all related or connected phenomena/elements at a subatomic level. This refinement makes Stilling completely colorless and invisible to the naked eye, although you can still adjust it to your liking. Examples include Tuning and controlling the vibrational wavelengths of atoms within all types and forms of matter and different frequencies of energy; tuning vibrations to direct and nudge directional vectors; vibrating molecules to pass through matter; and controlling all types and forms of waves, such as quantum or scalar waves. Your implied thinker aspects to support your abilities join forces, perceiving all vibrational frequencies and wavelengths.

addons.title: Stilling²
addons.description_html:
Whether it was your tuning field or your touch-based tuning fork, adaptively attuning your defenses or offenses revealed a somewhat obvious guess for what should've been obvious from the start: they are Stilling Buds geared towards adapting the user, both defensively and offensively.

Depending on your Bud, Stilling will absorb and integrate it to add either offensive or defensive traits to an already formidable ability. 

Tuning Field's understanding of a power's composition grants you the chance to counteract its effects when counterattacking, e.g., bypassing Gavel's damage reduction, interacting with and damaging Gasconade or Legend's Breaker forms, etc. 

Tuning Fork now acts through Stilling, everything within Stilling's effective area having a looping timer that makes them susceptible to Stilling's wavelengths, their timer now relative to how Stilling is effective against them. 

Regardless, the outcome would be the same, diminishing Parahuman effects, if not outright dealing with them, no matter the vector.

Yes, you heard right: thanks to Tuning Field or Tuning Fork, you don't need to be your power's origin point. Anywhere in a 500-meter radius where you perceive particle movements or wavelengths is enough to work.

This allows Stilling to adapt and understand phenomena it can emulate and take under its wing, at least within its basis, slowly expanding its sphere of influence the more phenomena or effects it scans.

title: (Shaker/Blaster) Fractal of Entropic Decay
description_html:
You have in your hands the power to control what the Entities have been dreading and try to stave off to escape their inevitable demise against: the phenomenon of Entropy. In their efforts to understand it, they spend copious amounts of time researching this.

At first, it’s viewed more as bare temperature manipulation, yet that’s further from the truth; it handles the amount of expended or unavailable energy in a system. A system in the physical sense can apply to anything, but is best described as a portion of the universe where changes take place in response to a set of conditions or the environment, which is then studied. It can be complex, such as a planet, or simple enough to fit in a beaker, as the liquid within a glass.

The “system” thus utilized for this power is an area of three city blocks around the user. This, being Shard-based, is quite limited in scope for the Entities’ concerns about Entropy.

An inherent part of this ability is an extant Thinker power to perceive energy and levels of energy of any kind or measure. Once the current level of entropy is determined, you can adjust it, resulting in a change in the system. This applies to anything, such as a glass of ice, a room, or a living organism, including yourself. 

A quirk of this ability is manifesting itself through a translucent stygian black energy field either as an aura or throughout your “system’s” range, and even somewhat a polar opposite to Stilling: ebony rays of unlight. Some applications are somewhat analogous to Stilling yet utterly antithetical in basis. Something to mull over…

The power is partitioned into three aspects: Containment, Diffusion, and Exhaustion:

Containment is the fine control or deceleration of Entropy to a microscopic and macroscopic level, which contains activation energy (the minimum amount of energy needed to initiate a reaction), among the chemical and physical phenomena that need energy to function or continue to occur. In turn, you can manipulate Entropy on a system or object to extend its timespan from its inevitable decay, violently disrupt a system’s integrity, and drastically cause system equilibrium by heating or freezing the system (or select parts).

Diffusion is the middle ground of Entropy, in which you diffuse, absorb, and assimilate energy through macroscopic control of Entropy. This is utilized as diffusing the area’s utilized energy (including the one’s parahuman powers use, effectively negating them), absorbing it to bolster the user’s physical and dynamic abilities, or assimilating the system’s resources in mass for various uses.

Exhaustion is the Entities’ fear, the only reason they stopped probing it: Entropy Acceleration. This is used to exhaust the system’s energy reserves responsible for structure and form, causing its breakdown, destabilizing anything within your range or particular liking, and having physical and radioactive effects. For example, on a smaller scale, you can decay anything from an appliance to a house if you let Exhaustion spread, weaponizing it to an anti-energy exponentially growing through propagation to any matter or energy on contact, or infuse it into a weapon for it to deteriorate anything the weapon damages or simply graze.

The only glaring weakness of having this power is its anathema: Negentropy. A Negentropic being can compete with you, yet depends on their energy generation/recovery: A negligible energy rate places the odds in your favor, while a formidable rate of energy recovery turns this into a battle of attrition in the Negentropic being’s favor.

Your command of physical (and perhaps metaphysical if you possess Shardless or Esoteric Knowledge) phenomena has widened to encompass Entropy as a variable to control in the confines of your power. This additive control deepens your perceptive abilities to better appreciate the blocks in which you build and mold reality within your range and has resulted in finding a clear awareness of the particular/quantum level through understanding what a “system” intrinsically is. The depth and scale of your abilities are doubled, in such a manner you grasp both spatiotemporal and/or dimensional phenomena more easily exploiting both of your powers’ pervasiveness.

addons.title: Rust
addons.description_html:
Your Entropic Control comes to degrade and wear down anything, so long as you have a clear idea and it is within your effective range. If you want to be as general and Exhaust as many objects or concepts as possible within the limits of your system, it'll sap most of the "system's" potential energy, leaving most of your power inert if Containment doesn't act as a counterweight. 

Focus on the notion of "memory", and everyone within your "system" will experience physical and mental symptoms of on-set dementia; focusing on the notion of "momentum", any form of ballistic physics is worn down to zero. This interaction essentially removes the Manton Limitation concerning other sapient/sentient species besides yourself.

raw_object_text_safe.text:
You have in your hands the power to control what the Entities have been dreading and try to stave off to escape their inevitable demise against: the phenomenon of Entropy. In their efforts to understand it, they spend copious amounts of time researching this.

At first, it’s viewed more as bare temperature manipulation, yet that’s further from the truth; it handles the amount of expended or unavailable energy in a system. A system in the physical sense can apply to anything, but is best described as a portion of the universe where changes take place in response to a set of conditions or the environment, which is then studied. It can be complex, such as a planet, or simple enough to fit in a beaker, as the liquid within a glass.

The “system” thus utilized for this power is an area of three city blocks around the user. This, being Shard-based, is quite limited in scope for the Entities’ concerns about Entropy.

An inherent part of this ability is an extant Thinker power to perceive energy and levels of energy of any kind or measure. Once the current level of entropy is determined, you can adjust it, resulting in a change in the system. This applies to anything, such as a glass of ice, a room, or a living organism, including yourself. 

A quirk of this ability is manifesting itself through a translucent stygian black energy field either as an aura or throughout your “system’s” range, and even somewhat a polar opposite to Stilling: ebony rays of unlight. Some applications are somewhat analogous to Stilling yet utterly antithetical in basis. Something to mull over…

The power is partitioned into three aspects: Containment, Diffusion, and Exhaustion:

Containment is the fine control or deceleration of Entropy to a microscopic and macroscopic level, which contains activation energy (the minimum amount of energy needed to initiate a reaction), among the chemical and physical phenomena that need energy to function or continue to occur. In turn, you can manipulate Entropy on a system or object to extend its timespan from its inevitable decay, violently disrupt a system’s integrity, and drastically cause system equilibrium by heating or freezing the system (or select parts).

Diffusion is the middle ground of Entropy, in which you diffuse, absorb, and assimilate energy through macroscopic control of Entropy. This is utilized as diffusing the area’s utilized energy (including the one’s parahuman powers use, effectively negating them), absorbing it to bolster the user’s physical and dynamic abilities, or assimilating the system’s resources in mass for various uses.

Exhaustion is the Entities’ fear, the only reason they stopped probing it: Entropy Acceleration. This is used to exhaust the system’s energy reserves responsible for structure and form, causing its breakdown, destabilizing anything within your range or particular liking, and having physical and radioactive effects. For example, on a smaller scale, you can decay anything from an appliance to a house if you let Exhaustion spread, weaponizing it to an anti-energy exponentially growing through propagation to any matter or energy on contact, or infuse it into a weapon for it to deteriorate anything the weapon damages or simply graze.

The only glaring weakness of having this power is its anathema: Negentropy. A Negentropic being can compete with you, yet depends on their energy generation/recovery: A negligible energy rate places the odds in your favor, while a formidable rate of energy recovery turns this into a battle of attrition in the Negentropic being’s favor.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Shaker/Blaster) Fractal of Entropic Decay

title: (Shaker) The Ultimate Question
description_html:
Your Shard contains information that is simultaneously the most priceless and worthless knowledge the Entities have. A burning desire that, despite over millions of years of research, they seem no closer to getting. Your shard contains the record of the closest they have gotten to Negentropy.

The basic theory was that since the Multiverse allows for infinite variation, it should be possible to harness infinite variations of energy. Unfortunately, the act of reaching out into the multiverse was simply too energy-exhausting, meaning that they absorbed less energy than they were expending. This doesn’t mean that this [Data] is useless, though; it just wasn’t what they were looking for. Ultimately, the information was repurposed to simulate and manipulate this energy for their own ends.

When using this power, a large 30-centimeter silvery white ring or “halo” will manifest itself around you, affecting things within a three-block radius. By default, it appears behind your head. You can change its location around you and even its size, but it will always manifest in your vicinity. This halo, while antithetical in application, is surprisingly analogous to Stilling in basis—a point of study, perhaps.

As stated previously, this power can be used in two basic ways known as [Simulation] and [Manipulation].

[Simulation] applies a constant rate of energy to an object or phenomenon. Originally designed to simulate how the universe’s energy generation works and how to possibly increase it, it has been repurposed to allow things like a bullet ignoring air resistance and gravity to fire in a perfectly straight line. If this sounds familiar, it should. This mechanic has been further refined into what modern Parahumans know as All-or-Nothing. Interestingly, it is possible to affect other Perfect powers within your radius, allowing you to increase their scope or even turn them “OFF,” so to speak.

[Manipulation] is the direct management of potential variations of energy within your area of effect. This is not energy control so much as potential energy manifestation. It transforms the unused potential energy, or zero-point energy, into other possible variations of said energy, such as electricity, seemingly making energy from nothing. It also allows you to effortlessly transform one type of energy into another, such as kinetic energy into thermal energy. It is also possible to return energy to its zero-point state. An example would be letting a nuclear bomb go off, only for the explosion to just disappear without leaving even a trace of radiation. When used like this, the added zero-point energy can be stored by your Shard to use on a later occasion. This potential energy absorption is the core mechanic by which Entities “feed” at the end of a [Cycle].

When using both [Simulation] and [Manipulation] together, it is possible to use [Simulation] as a framework through which to control energy changed by [Manipulation]. This allows you to focus the energy into specific directions and even release it outside of your range of control. This is a highly complex process, but you are given a minor Thinker power to help manage it all.

Should you possess genuine Negentropy, this power doesn’t change much. Rather, it becomes dedicated to managing your personal Negentropy, allowing you to finely control its framework and even increase its efficiency when affecting your other powers, enhancing all the benefits they may provide.

addons.title: Many-Worlds Interpretation
addons.description_html:
Ignis Fatuus ability to “flicker” through realities has revitalized the discarded [Data] of reaching out into the multiverse and successfully reformatted it into a more usable form, giving you the new power expression [Emulation].

[Emulation] is the management of potential variations of forms of matter. This allows you to change your environment to a different possible environment. You could be standing in a city only to “flicker” it into the desert it could have been in a different reality. It is also possible to only target specific objects such as turning a rusty knife into a laser blade. 

The direct manipulation of matter is possible when used in conjunction with both [Simulation] and [Emulation]. This allows you to optimize changes made to the environment to your favor, such as providing cover from attacks outside your range.

addons.title: Wave Function Collapse
addons.description_html:
The power of [Emulation] has expanded in scope, allowing you to combine multiple different versions of reality into one. This layering also benefits Ignis Fatuus as it allows you to combine different versions of yourself into a single version of you. This will be version of you will possess all the powers of the different versions of yourself and can even possess fusions of the powers depending on compatibility. However, fusing too many versions of yourself will be taxing on your shard.

An additional function has also been unlocked, [Annihilation]. This is process is done by combining [Simulation], [Manipulation], and [Emulation] all at once to cause combining realities to mutually destroy each other and turn into zero-point energy for your Shard. As you might have guessed, this is the specific mechanic by which Entities “feed” at the end of each [Cycle]. Performing this function, while efficient at small scales, becomes very energy dependent at larger ones. This only applies to the start-up process, which is why entities can apply it on a universal scale and still receive a generous amount of energy, but a single shard will simply die trying. A better example would be jumpstarting a full tank portable generator with a car battery versus trying to jumpstart it with a single AA battery.

That doesn’t mean you don’t have uses for it, however. Your thinker ability has combined with your ability to see representations of other’s powers to allow you to use this function in a defensive manner. Using the images provided as a basis, you can determine what possible action that your opponent is doing, target a reality where this action was successful, and purposefully destroy it, causing that specific action to fail. This is effectively a hard counter to powers such as Path to Victory due to you physically destroying the path they are using. It is possible for them to bait you into destroying a path that they aren’t going to use, but this requires them to manually decide to abandon said path since until it is destroyed, their shard will still determine it to be the best path.

addons.title: Electroweak Theory
addons.description_html: Your mastery of the electromagnetic spectrum has been enhanced to the point where you have obtained mastery over the other side of the coin, the weak interaction. Thanks to [Simulation] and [Emulation], you can control all forms of radiation and radioactive decay. You can not only shoot beams of radiation but can also transform radiation into either more safe or harmful forms depending on your needs. You can also accelerate all nuclear decay within The Ultimate Question’s radius, allowing you to disintegrate anything you want within three-blocks. Your breaker form is enhanced to allow you to turn most attacks against you into zero-point energy to be stored in your shard. All your energy blast may be made All-or-Nothing even if they escape The Ultimate Question’s radius.

addons.title: The Incomplete Quantum Paradigm
addons.description_html:
It is wonderful that we have yet to glimpse the totality of the Universe’s mysteries and wonders on such a small scale. The phenomenon of quantum entanglement exemplifies the yet unexplored lands of quantum mechanics, with you as the sole explorer. Ignis’ quantum superposition and exploration of Many-Worlds and Undying’s quantum determinism of existence harness quantum entanglement through The Ultimate Question’s infinite variations of energy signatures.

Quantum entanglement describes the occurrence of particles that, once connected, remain linked even over large distances. The parts of this interaction open The Ultimate Question to affect your surroundings as a Shaker effect.

This starts with Ignis Fatuus scouting for possible iterations, using Undying to gaze far ahead for their quantum “outcomes” and tagging these alternate worlds for later use. Then, you pinpoint something’s energy signature or potential energy variation to entangle it with said alternate world’s variation. This ends with said thing leaning towards the alternate’s future state similar to Undying’s maintenance of a quantum state/timeline without fail. This essentially controls something’s “fate” or causality as you set the effect or future state by ensuring a cause or current state’s progression.

addons.text:
Ignis Fatuus ability to “flicker” through realities has revitalized the discarded [Data] of reaching out into the multiverse and successfully reformatted it into a more usable form, giving you the new power expression [Emulation].

[Emulation] is the management of potential variations of forms of matter. This allows you to change your environment to a different possible environment. You could be standing in a city only to “flicker” it into the desert it could have been in a different reality. It is also possible to only target specific objects such as turning a rusty knife into a laser blade. 

The direct manipulation of matter is possible when used in conjunction with both [Simulation] and [Emulation]. This allows you to optimize changes made to the environment to your favor, such as providing cover from attacks outside your range.
addons.title: Many-Worlds Interpretation

addons.text:
The power of [Emulation] has expanded in scope, allowing you to combine multiple different versions of reality into one. This layering also benefits Ignis Fatuus as it allows you to combine different versions of yourself into a single version of you. This will be version of you will possess all the powers of the different versions of yourself and can even possess fusions of the powers depending on compatibility. However, fusing too many versions of yourself will be taxing on your shard.

An additional function has also been unlocked, [Annihilation]. This is process is done by combining [Simulation], [Manipulation], and [Emulation] all at once to cause combining realities to mutually destroy each other and turn into zero-point energy for your Shard. As you might have guessed, this is the specific mechanic by which Entities “feed” at the end of each [Cycle]. Performing this function, while efficient at small scales, becomes very energy dependent at larger ones. This only applies to the start-up process, which is why entities can apply it on a universal scale and still receive a generous amount of energy, but a single shard will simply die trying. A better example would be jumpstarting a full tank portable generator with a car battery versus trying to jumpstart it with a single AA battery.

That doesn’t mean you don’t have uses for it, however. Your thinker ability has combined with your ability to see representations of other’s powers to allow you to use this function in a defensive manner. Using the images provided as a basis, you can determine what possible action that your opponent is doing, target a reality where this action was successful, and purposefully destroy it, causing that specific action to fail. This is effectively a hard counter to powers such as Path to Victory due to you physically destroying the path they are using. It is possible for them to bait you into destroying a path that they aren’t going to use, but this requires them to manually decide to abandon said path since until it is destroyed, their shard will still determine it to be the best path.
addons.title: Wave Function Collapse

addons.text: Your mastery of the electromagnetic spectrum has been enhanced to the point where you have obtained mastery over the other side of the coin, the weak interaction. Thanks to [Simulation] and [Emulation], you can control all forms of radiation and radioactive decay. You can not only shoot beams of radiation but can also transform radiation into either more safe or harmful forms depending on your needs. You can also accelerate all nuclear decay within The Ultimate Question’s radius, allowing you to disintegrate anything you want within three-blocks. Your breaker form is enhanced to allow you to turn most attacks against you into zero-point energy to be stored in your shard. All your energy blast may be made All-or-Nothing even if they escape The Ultimate Question’s radius.

raw_object_text_safe.text:
Your Shard contains information that is simultaneously the most priceless and worthless knowledge the Entities have. A burning desire that, despite over millions of years of research, they seem no closer to getting. Your shard contains the record of the closest they have gotten to Negentropy.

The basic theory was that since the Multiverse allows for infinite variation, it should be possible to harness infinite variations of energy. Unfortunately, the act of reaching out into the multiverse was simply too energy-exhausting, meaning that they absorbed less energy than they were expending. This doesn’t mean that this [Data] is useless, though; it just wasn’t what they were looking for. Ultimately, the information was repurposed to simulate and manipulate this energy for their own ends.

When using this power, a large 30-centimeter silvery white ring or “halo” will manifest itself around you, affecting things within a three-block radius. By default, it appears behind your head. You can change its location around you and even its size, but it will always manifest in your vicinity. This halo, while antithetical in application, is surprisingly analogous to Stilling in basis—a point of study, perhaps.

As stated previously, this power can be used in two basic ways known as [Simulation] and [Manipulation].

[Simulation] applies a constant rate of energy to an object or phenomenon. Originally designed to simulate how the universe’s energy generation works and how to possibly increase it, it has been repurposed to allow things like a bullet ignoring air resistance and gravity to fire in a perfectly straight line. If this sounds familiar, it should. This mechanic has been further refined into what modern Parahumans know as All-or-Nothing. Interestingly, it is possible to affect other Perfect powers within your radius, allowing you to increase their scope or even turn them “OFF,” so to speak.

[Manipulation] is the direct management of potential variations of energy within your area of effect. This is not energy control so much as potential energy manifestation. It transforms the unused potential energy, or zero-point energy, into other possible variations of said energy, such as electricity, seemingly making energy from nothing. It also allows you to effortlessly transform one type of energy into another, such as kinetic energy into thermal energy. It is also possible to return energy to its zero-point state. An example would be letting a nuclear bomb go off, only for the explosion to just disappear without leaving even a trace of radiation. When used like this, the added zero-point energy can be stored by your Shard to use on a later occasion. This potential energy absorption is the core mechanic by which Entities “feed” at the end of a [Cycle].

When using both [Simulation] and [Manipulation] together, it is possible to use [Simulation] as a framework through which to control energy changed by [Manipulation]. This allows you to focus the energy into specific directions and even release it outside of your range of control. This is a highly complex process, but you are given a minor Thinker power to help manage it all.

Should you possess genuine Negentropy, this power doesn’t change much. Rather, it becomes dedicated to managing your personal Negentropy, allowing you to finely control its framework and even increase its efficiency when affecting your other powers, enhancing all the benefits they may provide.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Shaker) The Ultimate Question

title: (Breaker/Shaker) Embodiment of the Supernova
description_html:
You are able to transform into a person-shaped supernova, and in this state, you possess almost complete control over plasma and the ability to create a near-endless amount of it. You can create and manipulate plasma that is over a billion degrees Celsius and fire concentrated beams of plasma, along with creating and directing seas of plasma, with a mere thought.

You also gained immense control over gravity and radiation. Your gravity manipulation allows you to condense matter into black holes. Your control over gravity is such that you can prevent black holes from affecting matter. Your control over radiation is such that you can prevent others from being affected by your breaker state. create illusions by manipulating visible radiation and tapping into communications that use radio waves, and so on.

title: (Shaker/Changer) Cocytus
description_html:
Your power is to become, create, and manipulate ice; your body is naturally in a state of being a man made of ice, though you always look human.

This power allows you to ignore physical attacks by shattering around them, regrowing your ice body, or manipulating your body around the attack. Your body instinctually becomes ice when attacked; you can fight this.

You can create ice from nothing for up to half a mile in a sphere around you and freeze natural water for up to 2 miles (up to the molecular level). You have a secondary Thinker ability that allows you to sense all water in all its forms and create ice within your radius.

When more energy is expended, you can drop your ice's temperature to absolute zero. Killing all energy next to your ice immediately and making your ice strong enough to tank at least one hit from an Entity-level ability. If the focus is kept on the ice, the temperature will stay down, but if not, it will rapidly heat up to its normal temperature, superheating the area around it to a temperature above 15 °C.

It will take an immense amount of energy, but if you drop yourself to absolute zero, you gain the durability mentioned along with Alexandria-level strength. But your most notable ability is that time will freeze around you for as long as you stay at absolute zero. You can move and do things in this state, but it will expend more energy to do so and freeze those you hit during this time.

(This power will kill your Shard if used for more than 24 hours and rapidly decrease its life span when in use. Negentropy stops these negative effects.)

title: (Master/Trump) The Friend Bringer
description_html:
You gain the ability to summon and resend Alternate versions of Shardbearers that you meet, clones of the originals as well.

These summons will be perfectly loyal, but will still hold their personality, they will be given a general understanding of both your world and you upon summoning. They will sacrifice themselves and their morals to protect you and do what you say. Their powers start at 50% strength and after a full 1 month of being summoned, they are boosted to 200% of their normal strength from then on (This only happens once).

You are given a Thinker ability which allows you to perceive a mental rotating list of currently useful summons for the tasks you need done. You are given an Aura of 30 feet which counts as your range for the "meet" condition.
Endbringers and Entities can be summoned, alternates and clones alike, but only under the condition that you touch their core for Endbringers and for Entities to seriously injure them (To summon a clone or Alt. Leviathan you would need to touch its core; to summon a clone or Alt. Scion you would need to seriously injure his real body).

Every summoning takes Shard power and requires focus to keep active after they complete their original task, summoning Endbringers is an immense drain of both Shard energy and mental focus and will do serious damage to your Shard if held too long while Entity summons will instantly drop your shard to less than 1 week of energy left and knock you unconscious for at least 1 hour, they will shatter your Shard if summoned for longer than their task takes.
Summon's initial energy and focus requirements are substantially higher than continual summoning post-task. (Negentropy will completely nullify all the shard-based drawbacks of this power and half all mental drain).

This power will allow you to perform this ability with any "powered" individuals in the multiverse if taken with Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Ouranos
description_html:
You gain the ability to manipulate all oxygen within a 3-mile radius sphere around yourself, up to the atomic level. With powers of notable specificity aside (Cocytus being specified to Ice only, for example, but a normal waterbender isn't specific enough), you are the absolute authority when anything oxygen-based is involved, from air to water to certain acids, even with people up to 10 times your power.

You gain a secondary Thinker ability, which gives you knowledge (atomic position and bonds, and things directly interacting with it, like people walking through air, for example) of every Oxygen atom within your range.

This ability inherently lacks the usual Shard Manton Limit, allowing you to do things such as take or add oxygen to/from people or control them using their blood, etc.

Notable uses of this power include weather control in both the air and water involved, water manipulation (all forms) like the creation of Tsunamis and hyper-compressed water attacks, popping heads by filling them with oxygen, unbinding every Oxygen atom in your range, creating a 6-mile diameter sphere of desperately unstable atoms, and splitting or fusing the atoms in your range.

Your best attacks, from world-changing weather phenomena made by your power to nuclear detonations made by you splitting or fusing oxygen atoms, easily damage/destroy Endbringer, and do significant damage over large areas to even Entities.

Your best attacks, from world-changing weather phenomena made by your power to nuclear detonations made by you splitting or fusing oxygen atoms, easily damage/destroy Endbringer, and do significant damage over large areas to even Entities.

This control can be broken by having or being close to a Trigger Event or if their connection to their Shard altered drastically (Bonesaw or Panacea's work for example).

title: (Mover/Breaker) Time Out!
description_html: You can manipulate how fast time flows for you, in either direction, as much as you want. In other words, you can speed your perception and movement up to the point where time appears stopped, or slow it to the point where years pass in minutes, or more. You can interact with objects normally, as though they weren't frozen, or you can choose to have objects simply refuse to move. Strength is not increased despite your speed, but you can apply your normal force multiple times in a row for roughly the same effect. You are not able to rewind time with this power. If you speed up your perceptions, your aging is slowed to account for it in a way that you age as though the appropriate amount of time passed, instead of however much you experienced. If you are about to die, this power automatically stops time for you.

title: (Thinker/Trump) Sylar
description_html:
You can instantly learn and understand the workings and mechanics of anything, understand the complexity and exactness of organisms, objects, etc. without the need for long-term or special education, regardless of how simple or complex. This only helps with understanding the underlying mechanisms of the thing in question, it doesn't give any skills you didn't already possess.  Your shard obscures your ability to learn anything related to The Entities, such as the workings of the Cycle, but with enough time or if you have a good relationship with your shard, you can understand their workings.

By cutting into the brains of Parahumans to see and feel their Corona Pollentia and Gemma, you can understand how their power works, how to use them, and the best way to utilize them. You can even apply some minor adjustments to them.

title: (Breaker/Trump) Golden Form
description_html:
You’ve gained the ability to change into a powerful breaker form, converting your body into semi-solid/liquid energy, with its initial form resembling you in a full-body cloak of golden flames. All your abilities are massively enhanced from your previous form. A normal human would be capable of overpowering Alexandria in strength and durability, sheer speed to run from one side of the planet to the other in a minute, and a reaction time to easily handle that kind of speed. This enhancement is extended to all your abilities, including other powers. The breaker form can be confined to a single part or individual parts of your body if you wish, and switching between your normal form and breaker form will instantly heal any injury.

Alongside this is the ability to manipulate the energy your body is made from, allowing you to freely shape it into whatever you desire such as massive hands, a large animal form, or even weapons. The energy your body produces and is made from can be expelled as powerful blasts or used to imbue any other abilities you possess to further enhance them. You can channel any abilities you possess through your energy form as if they were your own body. You also possess a secondary ability allowing you unlimited multitasking in regards to your energy form.

You cannot access any of the abilities from the form without using your Breaker form and can choose to change the colors of your breaker form at will. The transformation between forms is instantaneous.

addons.title: Golden Dragon
addons.description_html:
Your inner dragon shines with an immeasurable golden light.

Your Golden Form’s energy mutates and enhances Dragon of Kyushu far more than it would normally. 

Due to the malleable nature of your Golden Form carrying over to your Draconic Power, you can now intentionally call up any mutation and alterations that you had previously undergone, able to freely shift your form from normal to the greatest heights you have ever reached and anywhere in between at will. 

Moreover by entering your Golden Form in of itself, alongside the normal enhancement you would typically have, you can now choose to consciously direct some or all of your enhancements and alterations, also able to freely shape the form as you normally would your energy form. 

You still gain 10% of each escalation to your base form as normal, but this now also includes the height of power you reach with Golden Form enhancing it.

title: (Shaker) Same Day Delivery!
description_html:
You can summon raw materials in a radius of 50 feet around you. The things you can summon can be any raw materials you can think of, as long as they are physically capable of existing; this means you would have to work with any metamaterials created by Tinkers before your power accepts them as viable for summoning. Notably, you can't summon finished products with this, but you can summon the component materials.

This power is hard to weaponize, but you can be creative, such as summoning mercury on top of someone, dropping a gold anvil on someone's head, and so on. Go forth and solve resource problems forever, for yourself or others.

title: (Stranger/Master) Self-Inserting for Days
description_html:
You can retroactively insert yourself in anything or anyone's story. If you wanted, everyone would think that you are the Hebert's youngest child. Or maybe you were always the president, even though you are clearly a minor. Cauldron? Of course, you know about them, you were there in their founding. Want to be a movie star? You are, you just started that movie, did you not? Can I get an autograph? Whatever new “Truth” you decide, the world will change to accept it: paper trail will be created for your convenience, statues for your glory, even the crater you made when you totally-one-shot an Endbringer. This affects everyone in the world. You can dismiss any narrative whenever you want, and no one will notice you leaving.

PS: Just because everyone believes you did something doesn't mean you did. So when you convince the world that you killed Scion, do try to act surprised when he shows up to save a kitten or something.

title: (Breaker/Shaker) Hellfire
description_html:
Flames can only burn so hot. The highest temperature recorded is two trillion kelvins. A supernova can exceed 100 billion degrees, and you're hotter than that.

Your body temperature has a secondary breaker effect that can be manipulated as a sort of field to contain your heat, extending upwards of 100 meters. 

Your heat is enough to even start the deconstruction and softening of Endbringer cores, very likely to even turn an Endbringer into nothing more than a gas.

Your range is as your eye can see, and your abilities mean you are completely immune to the very idea of heat. No amount of heat can scar or burn you. Your infernos are all under your control.

You can scale this temperature down.

You have no brute or breaker powers allowing you to survive extremes, but you are immune to any malignant effects heat might cause to your health. This includes smoke from fires.

title: (Brute/Shaker) Seed of Yggdrasil
description_html:
You are a seed of the tree that holds the worlds together. You have immense control over the entire Kingdom Plantae. All plants of your choice naturally flourish and provide endless bounty within 1000 miles of your location.

Within 100 miles of your location, you can force plants to grow in unnatural locations; blanket an entire city in green algae, grow an oak tree in the middle of an office, etc. The speed you can cause plants to grow in this range is fast enough for entire trees to grow within minutes.

Within 10 miles of your location, you have absolute control over all plant life. You can grow entire redwood trees faster than a blink of an eye. Any plant within this range can be used to express any of your other abilities. You can grow plants within people to gain access to their powers and control their actions. You are no longer limited to terrestrial plants in this region; you have free reign to combine, alter, or create brand-new plants within this area.

You have a Thinker ability that allows you to sense plants within your range relative to your level of control and a level of multitasking to match. You can interdimensionally connect the roots of your plants, allowing you to travel between them at your leisure; the interdimensionality of your roots can be extended to singular plants within your absolute range, allowing you to bypass barriers and other insurmountable defenses.

You can assume the properties of plants in any combination. At a minimum, you have a brute rating that grants you the strength to treat a pair of redwoods as mere chopsticks. Your durability resembles that of the cumulative durability of the plants within your absolute range. By adopting the properties of plants, you can grow your body into various shapes and sizes. So long as there are plants in your absolute range, you can recover from any injury that doesn't destroy your Corona Pollentia.

title: (Trump) Shard Supply Store
description_html:
You have an endless selection of powers in an archive of sorts. These powers are standardized components instead of finished products and can’t be used by themselves. You have the ability to fuse, modify, and forge these components together, creating greater powers from lesser shards. 
You can hold onto and use a limited number of these constructed powers at once or grant them to other people. 

In order to swap powers you must either deconstruct a power or grant it to another person. 
Your power will in time construct new components to replace any given away.

If you focus on making the strongest power you can it will be equivalent in strength to a tier 3 weaker than Shard Supply Store and completely fill your capacity for powers but if you focus on quantity above all else you will be able to construct around forty powers equivalent to low to mid-level tier 1 powers.

The construction of Trump powers follows different rules as Shard Supply Store does not directly allow the construction of powers that permanently alter its own rules or permanently connect to, copy, steal, or create other powers as a way to sidestep Shard Supply Store's limited capacity for powers, temporary or limited effects are allowed though. Powers are created while under the effect of an alteration to Shard Supply Stores rules and the effects of those powers are eliminated when the effect ends and can’t be given to others.

addons.title: Abzu
addons.description_html:
All the shards that make up (Trump) Shard Supply Store are now located in your dimension, giving you access to your own Shardspace. You can directly interact with all of these shards and your shard components now bud, grow and develop like normal shards. You're capable of modifying these shards to a limited extent and no longer have the same strict limits concerning Trump-related powers as before, allowing you to permanently copy, create and steal other powers. These actions will lead to new shards forming in your Shardspace.

You still have limitations with your capacity to express constructed powers but these have been eased and will further lessen over time. You possess the same limits as before in terms of the maximum strength of your powers but you can now wield three powers at once instead of just a single Tier 3 power before filling your capacity. Similarly, the maximum number of low to mid-level Tier 1 powers you can wield at once has also tripled. Note that using too many powers at once as well as wielding excessively potent powers will lead to your shards quickly running out of energy unless you possess Negentropy.

When giving powers to others, the shards remain in your dimension and so you retain full control, allowing you to influence them as you desire. Your relationship with your shards will always be positive, the shards themselves completely loyal to you. When you're using them, they will give significant leeway with your abilities and loosen restrictions. In time, you could grow and develop into something akin to that of an Entity.

title: (Shaker/Thinker) Be the Butterfly effect!
description_html:
At any time, you may enter a completely accurate simulation of the past created by your power; however, there is no past version of you in this simulation. Despite this, your presence is remembered, and any effects you had on the world at that point are maintained. You may choose to simulate any time within the last year. The simulation automatically ends if enough time passes in the simulation to reach the time you created that specific simulation. No time passes in the present while you are in the simulation. You enter this simulation in the past of the location you were at in the present if that space is unoccupied; if it is occupied, you appear in the nearest empty space. You are free to move around to any location in the simulation even across the universe or local multiverse, and if you end the simulation, you appear in the nearest empty space to the location you were at in the simulation. Being killed in the simulation automatically ends it returning you to the present unharmed.
 
You may interact with the simulation with your body and powers, with everything and everyone within reacting just as the original would to anything you do. Changes you make to the simulation ripple out and affect the present within a few city blocks of your exit point, as if what you did in the simulation actually happened in the past.

For example, if you kill or save the life of somebody in the "past", but their body isn’t within a few blocks of your body in the present, then nothing happens to them. This can’t be used to create temporal clones of people, so if you trap someone in a location they would not be at in the present and end the simulation at that location, but the original's body isn’t nearby in the present, then they won’t remember being trapped there or interacting with you at that time, and there won’t be a copy of them at that location.

title: (Thinker) Path to Victory
description_html:
You can see the steps needed to accomplish any goal you wish, provided it’s feasible, and you can execute each step perfectly. You can choose to let your power take over to follow each step in your place.

You can have as many paths as you wish, capable of removing, altering, or adding to them at will. You can view the entirety of the path without actually following it, allowing you to use it as a method of gaining information.

Your power will understand the spirit of your goals instead of merely the letter, accounting for things you may have forgotten to think of.

This power operates by peering into the infinite possible paths through time and finding one where your goal is accomplished, as such it is true precognition.

addons.title: Titan Fortuna
addons.description_html: As a Titan, your power has gained a new dimension. Path to Victory is a true precognitive ability; it scans through time to find the sequence of actions that leads to success, and then allows you to follow it, but this process has always carried an inherent limitation. When Path to Victory observes the future, it makes that future fixed. The act of seeing collapses the wave of possibilities into one solid chain of events, a form of Temporal Quantum Entanglement.Once viewed, that future cannot be changed, only chosen or ignored in favor of another path. Now, that restriction is gone. Rather than simply observing one possible path and locking it in, you can see every possible outcome to an event, every probability no matter how small, and choosewhich one becomes real. At first glance, this might sound like a small difference. In practice, it changes everything. Before, Path to Victory might see a future where you run into a wall and break your nose, then discard it for another where you open the door beside it. One future becomes fixed, the other ignored. Now, you can see the full spectrum of possibilities, the one where you hit the wall, the one where you open the door, the one where your atoms align perfectly to slip through it, the one where quantum fluctuations conveniently reshapes the wall to let you pass, the one where a passing vehicle destroys it seconds before impact, and every other impossible possibility. Every possible event exists. This means even the most unlikely, microscopic chances can be forced to occur, improbable coincidences aligning perfectly. A pocket of particles might spontaneously arrange into the exact technology you need. Terrain might reshape itself through micro-events that just happen to occur in the right sequence. Matter itself might ripple and fold to clear the way, or shift into a new configuration. A diplomat may misread a message in the one way that causes them to choose the perfect response for your plan. Someone may make a decision entirely on their own, for their own reasons, and yet it happens to be exactly what you needed. Your Path to Victory is far more flexible, far more powerful.

title: (Tinker) Clarketech
description_html:
Your Shard held a very important purpose, that being collecting and storing data on technology and tinkertech that has broken previous cycles and could break future cycles. This was obviously never meant to be distributed in a cycle without heavy restrictions. Oops. As a result, you hold a Tinker specialty unlike any other, the incredibly broad and potent specialty of Clarketech, technology so advanced that it is indistinguishable from magic. 

Machines hidden away in pocket dimensions creating holographic interfaces in the air serving as the equivalent to smartphones, zero-point energy-powered flying broomsticks, nanotech-based healing potions, and multidimensional structures are just the tip of the iceberg as you begin making technology that blurs the line between the possible and impossible. 

Negentropy enables you to make use of negentropy in your own Clarketech.

addons.title: Clericus Techno-Magica
addons.description_html:
There is technology so advanced it is indistinguishable from magic. Then we have magic so analyzed it is simply science. Now we have YOU, a living nightmare for any entity’s cycle. You have fully broken the limits on what technologies the entities would allow fusing magic and science as one.

By quantifying the mysteries of magic under the lens of science and advancing them to the point of mystery once more, it could be said that you are truly attempting to play God. No, let me rephrase that. It is to MAKE Gods and use them as glorified USB sticks. Even if your tinkertech is white-boxed, it is so advanced and esoteric that you might as well speak Klingon to a caveman. Your technology doesn’t blur the line between the possible and impossible, it breaks it apart for you to use as toothpicks.

You can make white holes for use in guns, manufacture exotic matter in 3D printers, and turn people into living energy to put them into computers that exist outside of spacetime. Worst of all, with the limits broken, you can create tinkertech designed against the entities directly. This is why you are the entities’ nightmare, why they actively put locks on what can and cannot be built in a cycle. At the height of your technology could even trap an entity in an interdimensional net, one where eons could pass in mere instants, and you could siphon their power to you as you please, turning them into just another resource. Suffice to say, you should make sure that the entities never find out about this, at least before you make “preparations”.

title: (Shaker/Breaker) Sleeper
description_html: "Do not wake the Evil while it is quiet" You’ve gained the ability to create, manipulate, and turn into an incredibly powerful storm, a cloud that shimmers in rainbow colors and cracks, pops, and boils. Your storm allows you to subvert everything inside it, gaining the ability to control and manipulate it freely. This allows you to reshape and manipulate anyone and anything inside of your storm, including yourself. This also grants you awareness of everything inside your storm. From the manipulation of matter and energy to simple master effects on others, all falls under your domain. The effects do not fade when the storm disappears, the effects remaining permanent until undone. Incredibly powerful All-or-Nothing of absolute attacks and defenses can resist subversion for a while, however if they stay in the storm for too long even they will fail. The speed at which things are subverted to your own use is instantaneous, barring All-or-Nothing effects, for which they’ll have to spend a few minutes inside before they too fall under your control. You’re also capable of shifting your body into a breaker state made up of your storm, which will allow you to reform yourself anywhere inside the storm, reshape, harden it, or manipulate its properties as you wish. You can even manifest and reshape your storm as a coat of armor and weapons. When shifted into your breaker form you also become capable of directly manifesting your power’s effects outside the storm itself, such as launching powerful blasts of lightning. When shifted into your breaker form you also become capable of healing any damage to yourself, capable of reforming near instantly, and while in the breaker form itself any damage to the storm is not reflected to your own body, instead forcing it back into human form no worse for wear if your storm is completely annihilated. When shifted into your breaker form the speed at which your storm swells also grows, and you become able to move your storm. The storm can remain active constantly even without your direct input, covering the same area forever, even while you sleep if desired. You can manifest your storm anywhere within a large initial 10km radius around yourself, however it can swell up in size incredibly quickly, capable of growing to envelop multiple settlements or even large portions of a megacity within minutes. The storm’s size will grow at the same rate, capable of growing faster the more it grows. If you possess an ability that allows you control over the weather, storms, and/or clouds, your range’s initial radius is increased to whatever you the largest range is among those powers. You are able to use the storm’s ability to its fullest potential even without knowing exactly how it works.

title: (Breaker/Changer) Ash Beast
description_html:
You’ve gained an unexplored yet incredibly potent form of matter-energy/energy-matter conversion, best explained by Einstein’s Theory of Special Relativity, where it is posited energy and mass (matter) are interchangeable, being different forms of the same thing.

As normally uncontrollable as this power would be, both in usage and premise of “the more Shard gives in power, the more it takes in mind” to the point where you experience a case of ego death not unlike Khepri or Night Hag, you miraculously maintain both your sanity and control at the cost of the full capacity of this power being locked behind conscious input.

You have a Breaker form generated and comprised from your constant transmutation of energy and matter, being energetic in nature it gains side benefits such as superhuman conditioning; survival without oxygen, diseases, and contaminants; and flawless and constant regeneration; all of this is possible through your Breaker form constantly replacing and rearranging itself amidst your explosions and replenishing itself from ambient or surrounding energies, absorbing it like fire, to maintain and augment this form.

In your Breaker form, you incessantly produce near-uncontrollable explosions around your surroundings from the constant conversion of matter-energy, with the advantage of changing your shape or form from tearing and putting yourself back together from steady explosions.

Mover powers based on portals and teleportation face difficulties in working their powers on when transformed in your Breaker form, as it chaotically disrupts any grip it has on you.

To reiterate, thanks to being in your control, it has halved its potency, recovering its past benchmark to a sheer outpouring of energy, exhausting your reserves, or simply letting your power loose.

Being a question in regards to the lengths this power is capable of, there are some undiscovered applications that anybody hasn’t thought of or gone unsaid.
