addons.title: Unspool
addons.description_html:
Your Breaker form has gained the composition of an Endbringer, with your flesh compounding both as an energy-dense, extremely durable, and layered vitreous material, losing any sense of pain or loss of efficacy from damage, while also retaining Typhon’s physical enhancement and percentual power amplification. 

Your Breaker form, with this, develops in flexibility and potency: energy absorption and explosive emission can branch out from more than one type of energy or matter, from chromodynamic to geothermal control or explosions; energy shapeshifting grows to be more liberal on the shapes and composition you emulate, from a volcanic giant hand to a nuclear stomp.

addons.title: Unravel
addons.description_html:
Your Breaker form has gained the composition of an Endbringer, while also obtaining a step further: a Titan Form where Ash Beast’s cycle-imposed restrictions are lifted to be on a level of a rebel/rampant Shard pulling all stops on his specialization. With Typhon, your compounds both as an energy-dense, extremely durable, and layered vitreous material, losing any sense of pain or loss of efficacy from damage, while retaining Typhon’s physical enhancement and percentual power amplification. With Cronus, it pushes this to its logical extreme, now using your energy-matter conversion as a damage deterrent.

You can seamlessly shift between your Breaker form and Titan form, with the difference being the enormity of it, a rampant fluctuating physical form with the latter.

Your Breaker form, with this, develops in flexibility and potency: energy absorption and explosive emission can branch out from more than one type of energy or matter, from chromodynamic to geothermal control or explosions; energy shapeshifting grows to be more liberal on the shapes and composition you emulate, from a volcanic giant hand to a nuclear stomp. This widens with Cronus: Allowing the creation of constructs, energetic-material manipulation, and full control of your combustive energies.

addons.title: Debasement
addons.description_html:
Your Energy-Matter and Entropy powers have bleed over each other, Ash Beast’s energy-matter conversion accelerates the rate at which your “system” reaches equilibrium, both Diffusing and Exhausting any surrounding matter or energy all over your surroundings as opposed to simply exposing mass and energy into a constant equivalence. To fully explain this, it invites the absorption or diffusion of leftover energy lost amidst Ash Beast’s conversion at the same time leading to an equilibrated “system” to its logical extreme: no energy or matter to speak of, leaving all inert or dead. 

You can toggle this on and off, though, you don’t want to welcome the Heat Death, do you?

Far from the wanton destruction this apparently is, it has a method to its madness; all that you obliterate you lay claim to, having dominion over anything you destroy, remaking it either as exactly as it were, a replica, or whatever you desire. Meaning, that anything you devastate can be recreated to be fully in your control, whether it is adjusting reality or just molding the physical world, varies.

addons.title: Wrath of the Dying Star
addons.description_html:
Your power fuses continuous matter-energy conversion with controlled plasma detonation, creating a system where every explosion you generate does not dissipate but instead fuels the next in a sustained chain reaction. Unlike standard concussive explosions, the energy released is immediately converted into plasma, which propagates outward, ionizing and destabilizing surrounding matter. This results in a cascading effect where destruction spreads systematically, rather than chaotically, allowing for precise direction and escalation of plasma-based devastation.  

Thermal energy from these plasma detonations does not simply dissipate into the environment. Instead, it is reabsorbed and redirected, ensuring a continuous energy cycle that sustains further reactions. This prevents heat diffusion, meaning the battlefield remains in a constant state of high-energy flux as long as power is applied. Due to the plasma’s ionization properties, any conductive material caught within these detonations experiences structural breakdown, leading to rapid degradation of mechanical and electronic systems. The electromagnetic discharge from sustained plasma reactions also generates localized interference fields, disrupting technology and overloading unprotected electronic devices.  

The presence of extreme heat amplifies the effects of explosive energy conversion. Matter within the affected area is rapidly heated to temperatures exceeding standard combustion limits, causing spontaneous vaporization rather than gradual burning. At peak intensity, this heat input allows for the projection of high-energy radiation bursts, which can cause widespread thermal damage at a distance. The release of electromagnetic pulses further enhances disruption capabilities, with the most intense bursts capable of shorting out advanced energy-based systems. Once a reaction is initiated, the combination of plasma expansion, sustained heat buildup, and electromagnetic interference makes neutralizing its effects increasingly difficult.

Instead, it is reabsorbed and redirected, ensuring a continuous energy cycle that sustains further reactions. This prevents heat diffusion, meaning the battlefield remains in a constant state of high-energy flux as long as power is applied. Due to the plasma’s ionization properties, any conductive material caught within these detonations experiences structural breakdown, leading to rapid degradation of mechanical and electronic systems. The electromagnetic discharge from sustained plasma reactions also generates localized interference fields, disrupting technology and overloading unprotected electronic devices.  

The presence of extreme heat amplifies the effects of explosive energy conversion. Matter within the affected area is rapidly heated to temperatures exceeding standard combustion limits, causing spontaneous vaporization rather than gradual burning. At peak intensity, this heat input allows for the projection of high-energy radiation bursts, which can cause widespread thermal damage at a distance. The release of electromagnetic pulses further enhances disruption capabilities, with the most intense bursts capable of shorting out advanced energy-based systems. Once a reaction is initiated, the combination of plasma expansion, sustained heat buildup, and electromagnetic interference makes neutralizing its effects increasingly difficult.

addons.text:
Your Breaker form has gained the composition of an Endbringer, with your flesh compounding both as an energy-dense, extremely durable, and layered vitreous material, losing any sense of pain or loss of efficacy from damage, while also retaining Typhon’s physical enhancement and percentual power amplification. 

Your Breaker form, with this, develops in flexibility and potency: energy absorption and explosive emission can branch out from more than one type of energy or matter, from chromodynamic to geothermal control or explosions; energy shapeshifting grows to be more liberal on the shapes and composition you emulate, from a volcanic giant hand to a nuclear stomp.
addons.title: Unspool

addons.text:

addons.title: Unravel

addons.text: Ash Beast and the Dragon of Kyushu fuse into one, acquiring a Draconic Form alongside your normal Breaker form, with all the characteristics of Dragon of Kyushu integrating its Escalation mechanics and payoff and Ash Beast’s malleable form.
addons.title: Salamander

addons.text:

raw_object_text_safe.text:
You’ve gained an unexplored yet incredibly potent form of matter-energy/energy-matter conversion, best explained by Einstein’s Theory of Special Relativity, where it is posited energy and mass (matter) are interchangeable, being different forms of the same thing.

As normally uncontrollable as this power would be, both in usage and premise of “the more Shard gives in power, the more it takes in mind” to the point where you experience a case of ego death not unlike Khepri or Night Hag, you miraculously maintain both your sanity and control at the cost of the full capacity of this power being locked behind conscious input.

You have a Breaker form generated and comprised from your constant transmutation of energy and matter, being energetic in nature it gains side benefits such as superhuman conditioning; survival without oxygen, diseases, and contaminants; and flawless and constant regeneration; all of this is possible through your Breaker form constantly replacing and rearranging itself amidst your explosions and replenishing itself from ambient or surrounding energies, absorbing it like fire, to maintain and augment this form.

In your Breaker form, you incessantly produce near-uncontrollable explosions around your surroundings from the constant conversion of matter-energy, with the advantage of changing your shape or form from tearing and putting yourself back together from steady explosions.

Mover powers based on portals and teleportation face difficulties in working their powers on when transformed in your Breaker form, as it chaotically disrupts any grip it has on you.

To reiterate, thanks to being in your control, it has halved its potency, recovering its past benchmark to a sheer outpouring of energy, exhausting your reserves, or simply letting your power loose.

Being a question in regards to the lengths this power is capable of, there are some undiscovered applications that anybody hasn’t thought of or gone unsaid.

title: (Thinker/Master) Burning Bridges
description_html:
You see glowing strings coming out of everyone, those strings connect to everyone that a being has interacted with. Looking at the strings gives you insight on those connections, like whether the connection is friendly, hostile, or nonexistent, or things like when it started or why it ended.

Through those strings you can doom a connection, you can decide what will be the outcome but not how it will be achieved or you can leave the outcome as random, the outcome could be something like "Being B decides to kill Being A" or "Being A ends their friendship with Being B by destroying their family heirloom", or even "Being B kills Being A fiance and Being A triggers with the power to raise undead". How it happens is by Being A and B and every being that was/is around them in the past and present have their decisions and actions subtly influenced in a way that achieves the desired outcome. You decide to doom Being A and Being B's friendship and sometime later Being B discovers their significant other has had an affair with Being A, resulting in that friendship ending.

Touching someone allows you to see and interact with their strings even when they are on the other side of the world, and gives you access to their connection to those they haven't interacted with. You could make the entire world hate a single person and no one would even know it was you.

title: (Trump/Master) Chrysalis
description_html:
You gain the capacity to sense sentiments and desires within 100 kilometers of you. By concentrating on the sentiments/desires someone is feeling, you gain knowledge of what caused them and can hear what they are currently thinking.
 
You are able to create white butterflies that you can sense through and command them by giving them orders telepathically, though this telepathic link only works within the range of your emotion sense. Within you, there's a large pool of energy that you can imbue into one of your butterflies through touch. This turns that butterfly into a Kamiko, and their colour becomes black with highlights of a colour of your choice. The pool regenerates slowly, but eating food fills it completely, and with time, it will grow in size. Kamikos are extremely flexible, giving them the capacity to pass through very small gaps and be able to sense emotions in a much smaller range than yours. You can only have one Kamiko at a time; trying to make another one will just result in you wasting the energy from your pool.

Your Kamiko can possess an object that someone has an emotional connection with; the possessed object becomes black, a mental connection with that being is established, and their sentiments/desires are amplified and reinforced. This connection allows you to access their senses and telepathically communicate with them. Every time you do that, a glowing (with the colour of the highlight of your Kamiko) outline of a mask in the shape of a butterfly appears in front of their and your faces. You can offer them a transformation that will change their body, make them have unlimited stamina, and give them powers (being able to amplify and change existing ones), together with a name for this transformation. If they agree to it, their body will be engulfed by a bubbling energy of the colour of your Kamiko, upon which the change is made, and they will become your Champion. If their object breaks, their transformation ends, and all their active power effects will cease to exist. The same applies if you make the Kamiko leave its object. Although you normally can only have one Champion at a time due to your Kamiko limit, if multiple people share the same object and their sentiments and desires align, they will become multiple Champions or fuse into a single one. You can only retrieve a Kamiko and communicate with your Champion within your emotional sense range.

The powers from the transformation are fueled by your pool of energy, and the stronger they are, the more energy they consume, while the maximum strength of the powers you can give is 30 SP total. The transformation must align with your Champions sentiments/desires, the context behind those feelings, and themselves. You can't give someone who refuses to hurt anyone under any circumstances a power that can only be used to hurt, nor can you give someone who is tired of running away from their problems sentient minions that they can command from another city, but you could give the first one a power whose capacity to hurt is secondary or give the second one the capacity to create clones that house his consciousness. If you Champion yourself, you won't be able to change or amplify Chrysalis, and if a Champion has the capacity to amplify or grant powers to others, it must be either temporary, limited to only 1 or both.

If you have Shardless or Esoteric Knowledge, your pool of energy will instead be magic aligned with the concepts of Transmission, Influence, and Change, with each concept giving you an extra ability; with Transmission comes the capacity to temporarily transfer to your Champions any of your powers with the exception of Chrysalis; with Influence comes the capacity to compel someone to accept your offer of Championship and with Change comes the capacity for a transformation to become permanent. If your Champion stays transformed for a long time, the stronger the Champion the more time they need. If a Champion becomes permanent, they no longer need your Magic to use their powers, and you can use your Kamiko on someone else. You are still able to communicate with them as if they had a Kamiko. Besides that, it allows your Champions to actually have esoteric abilities like magic instead of imitations, and with time and effort, you can develop new capabilities based on those concepts or enhance ones that you already have (like making your Kamiko phase through walls). Those capabilities will use your pool of magic to function.

title: (Changer/Striker) Echidna
description_html:
With some alterations, you gain the horrific ability to clone anything you touch. Clones will typically resemble their source template but will still be distinctly different. You only have to have touched something once to make clones of them.

Things you clone are generally more powerful than their sources, typically healthier, and overall better in almost every way.

In the case of parahumans those you clone will typically possess a greater and/or alternate version of their source's power. You can choose what category they fall in or leave it entirely up to chance.

You can shapeshift into a giant, monstrous new form looking like a gray and red glob. This form is where you generate the clones, creating them directly inside the glob and releasing them. Your changer form can start incorporating the features of those you’ve cloned, becoming more mobile and powerful over time.

Clones will typically possess personalities similar to their sources, but will be innately loyal to you and won’t act against you, your goals, or instructions regardless of other factors. Note that this does not exclude them from being tricked or mastered to do so, only that they won’t do so willingly. If you’re Shardless or possess Esoteric Knowledge you can choose to make any of your clones Shardless as well.

addons.title: Angrboda
addons.description_html:
(Master) Cloning has been assimilated into this power and greatly enhanced it. Now, you are able to sense through any clone you create. Additionally, upon contact with a living being, the clone automatically stores the creature's template, allowing you to use that template to create new clones. Furthermore, you can temporarily grant any clone a base version of your changer state, allowing you to create clones through them.

Should you take any of the upgrades of (Master) Cloning, it will also be assimilated.

addons.title: Blueprint
addons.description_html:
Your power doesn’t just create direct clones, instead your power allows you to analyze and store the information from anything you touch, which you can then incorporate into anything you work on later. You can still create clones of them at will. 

This allows you to perform acts such as incorporating the powers of a Parahuman into someone else, creating exact clones of someone except loyal to yourself, to even creating the equivalent of possible children of templates you have had the opportunity to touch. 

This also allows you to generate clones without turning into your changed form, simply needing to touch biological material to affect it as you would with Panacea. On the flip side, your changer form can also be used to generate new things wholesale for your biokinetic abilities, allowing you to create things directly out of the glob. 

This allows you to incorporate the features of all that you would have normally just cloned into anything you work.

addons.title: Spectral Clones

addons.text:
(Master) Cloning has been assimilated into this power and greatly enhanced it. Now, you are able to sense through any clone you create. Additionally, upon contact with a living being, the clone automatically stores the creature's template, allowing you to use that template to create new clones. Furthermore, you can temporarily grant any clone a base version of your changer state, allowing you to create clones through them.

Should you take any of the upgrades of (Master) Cloning, it will also be assimilated.
addons.title: Angrboda

addons.text:
Your power doesn’t just create direct clones, instead your power allows you to analyze and store the information from anything you touch, which you can then incorporate into anything you work on later. You can still create clones of them at will. 

This allows you to perform acts such as incorporating the powers of a Parahuman into someone else, creating exact clones of someone except loyal to yourself, to even creating the equivalent of possible children of templates you have had the opportunity to touch. 

This also allows you to generate clones without turning into your changed form, simply needing to touch biological material to affect it as you would with Panacea. On the flip side, your changer form can also be used to generate new things wholesale for your biokinetic abilities, allowing you to create things directly out of the glob. 

This allows you to incorporate the features of all that you would have normally just cloned into anything you work.
addons.title: Blueprint

addons.text: Your ability to summon shades of Elfame allows you to forgo the traditional method of creating a clone, instead, you can now sacrifice a slot to immediately make a creation with the features you want. The slot will regenerate after 1 hour.
addons.title: Instant Creation

raw_object_text_safe.text:
With some alterations, you gain the horrific ability to clone anything you touch. Clones will typically resemble their source template but will still be distinctly different. You only have to have touched something once to make clones of them.

Things you clone are generally more powerful than their sources, typically healthier, and overall better in almost every way.

In the case of parahumans those you clone will typically possess a greater and/or alternate version of their source's power. You can choose what category they fall in or leave it entirely up to chance.

You can shapeshift into a giant, monstrous new form looking like a gray and red glob. This form is where you generate the clones, creating them directly inside the glob and releasing them. Your changer form can start incorporating the features of those you’ve cloned, becoming more mobile and powerful over time.

Clones will typically possess personalities similar to their sources, but will be innately loyal to you and won’t act against you, your goals, or instructions regardless of other factors. Note that this does not exclude them from being tricked or mastered to do so, only that they won’t do so willingly. If you’re Shardless or possess Esoteric Knowledge you can choose to make any of your clones Shardless as well.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Changer/Striker) Echidna

title: (Stranger) Shroud
description_html:
You can become completely undetectable both from a conventional and parahuman standpoint. This power comes from an endeavor to refine and specialize a Cloak Shard toward survivorship through imperceptibility from other Entities while being a culmination of different Stranger Shards into one. Being selectively customizable to your needs or concerns, the methods can vary according to one’s environment and opposition.

From a standard perspective, anyone is unable to perceive or recognize you in any shape or form, on a physical aspect, your power shrouds you off the electromagnetic spectrum turning translucently invisible, subtly canceling vibrations in your vicinity turning you inaudible, masking your scent to blend with the environment, dispersing your temperature signature, retroactively modifying any existent records or media as if you never appeared, your physical presence is essentially muted to the point of turning you selectively intangible; mental aspects such as using perceptive amnesia, distorting anyone’s memories, awareness and perceptions as to obscure your profile or mislead them to cover-up your intentions or actions; this can be used offensively for surprise and unperceivable attacks in combat situations.
From a parahuman perspective, Thinker powers enhancing and expanding the sensorial and intellectual range find themselves struck out from the power’s concealment, effectively removing you from their sights as if you weren’t there to begin with. Thinker powers based on simulating, data crunching, postcognition, pericognition, and precognition come up blank when assessing you, selectively obscuring aspects of yourself to either be a non-person to their powers or simply unsuspecting, effectively employing antimemetic mechanics.

The parahuman aspect is adaptive, appraising the probable vulnerability in the face of detection and responding accordingly.

This is feasibly regarded as the epitome of Stranger powers, with their mechanics using multiple methods of stealth, from physics to multi-dimensional exploitation to camouflage. Despite all this, the weaknesses you’ll encounter are Endbringers and Entities, which come from circumventing your abilities through the Cycle’s rules.

addons.title: Enshroud
addons.description_html: Your ability to hide traps has been integrated into Shroud, allowing make any object you have touched covered by your shroud. This allows you to prevent any important documents, stashes of money, or your hard drive of homework from being detected by anything weaker than shroud itself. Your shroud will also adapt to the object in question, allowing it to things such as deflect sub-routines for files, encrypted and hidden from forensics; obfuscate and misdirect fields for large or group of objects; remove scents and so on. It is also possible to indirectly shroud others if they are in contact with one of these items. You can revoke this at any time.

addons.title: Hidden One
addons.description_html:
Knowledge is power, and you know this better than most. Your immunity takes upon a new dimension to itself.

You’ve been rendered completely immune to being perceived by Thinker abilities. Your future and past cannot be observed, clairvoyants cannot detect you, danger senses cannot warn their users about you, and even models constructed by the user's knowledge yield no results. 

This is pervading enough that you cannot even be perceived by noticing the blind spots in their sight, such powers simply acting as if you didn’t exist. 

This doesn’t prevent others from perceiving you or making their own conclusions, only that their powers will be of no help. 

You can still use Shroud’s normal ability to conceal yourself as normal, whether in the physical sense or otherwise.

As before you can, at will, allow selected thinker powers to perceive or set up parameters for which they work, such as when a specific person is using it or only when it is beneficial for you. You can rescind this allowance at will at any time.

title: (Trump) Rival
description_html:
You are the enemy of all, for you become stronger the more opponents you have. This happens with your power adding the capabilities of everything that is opposing you or that is within 10 meters of yourself; if your opponents can do something, so can you. Intellect, bio-tinker augmentations, stamina, powers, visualization, multi-tasking, teleportation through tinkertech, and much more are yours to have.

Mundane Physical capabilities will only come from the one who has them the most while Mental and Abnormal (compared to average humans) capabilities will come from everyone, the same applies to equipment. Strength, Speed, and Stamina are an example of the first while Skills, Knowledge, and Powers are examples of the second. If an opponent’s physical capabilities weaken compared to others, you’ll draw from the next most capable opponent. For example, if you fought a mob of mooks and their leader’s stamina dropped significantly, you’d start absorbing the stamina of the mook who had the most. And if you faced someone with a gun, you’d find yourself able to shoot bullets at the same rate as them—whether from your fingers, palm, or thin air.

However, all these capabilities vanish the moment the opponents stop opposing you and move out of your range.

title: (Trump) Jailbreak
description_html:
You’ve gained the ability to access and control the abilities of others and yourself in a broad but imprecise manner. 

This will allow you to remove restrictions, enhance abilities, alter them in broad strokes, and more. However this comes with inherent risks, one that must be carefully managed lest it kill it their wielder’s, and more importantly you.

The power works through touch and line of sight. 

The power works through three major methods. Power Amplification, Aspect Infusion, and Category Expansion. 

Power Amplification is the simplest method, through which you simply amplify the powers existing aspects. For example a telekinetic would be able to generate significantly more force and/or possess much more fine control. 

Category Expansion allows you to add additional capabilities to the power expression directly, allowing it to manifest new features. For example by adding a Master component to a pyrokinetic power it could allow the user to create sentient fire constructs.  

Aspect Infusion adds new aspects to the theme of a power, creating a new dimension to the overall power. For example by adding an aspect of weakening to a Trump focused on amplifying others, it could allow them to instead directly attack others by striping them of strength instead of enhancing them. This can also be used to remove specific limitations such as the Manton limit. 

These alterations can only be chosen in a broad manner, how many times it affects someone, how potent the effects are, and what categories and aspects are added, but the specifics on how these amplifications manifest are uncontrollable.

Each modification carries inherent risks that escalate with proximity of each successive alterations. For Power Amplification, a quintupling of the power’s potency can be considered enough to hit the end requirements of the first phase, with the multiplier’s maximum to hit the next phase doubling for each additional phase. 

The first phase, the initial alteration, will typically result in no alteration to the mechanics of the powers. 

For the second phase, Trigger Happy, the power will start to activate on its own at times. 

This can lead to unforeseen and potentially disastrous consequences, there aren’t many things one can say to explain why while in their civilian identity their heat vision activated all of a sudden and eviscerated a swath of innocents. 

For the third phase, Instinct Erosion, normally instinctive control over powers is lost. 

The user will need conscious effort to preform actions that were once reflexive. Brute powers that enhance your strength may have you accidentally ripping the arm off of someone you tried to shake the hand of, and powers that require a high degree of precision will be a nightmare to deal with.

For the fourth phase, Protection Nullification, inherent safeguards are stripped away, 

This greatly increases the risk of self harm or unintended consequences in the environment. This can result in your own powers burning you, cutting you, potentially backfiring in a permanently damaging if not lethal manner. 
 
For the fifth phase, Volatile Surge, results in the powers becoming incredibly volatile, risking catastrophic failure and complete loss of control. 

One progresses through each phase for each successive alteration within three months of the previous one, and will drop to the previous phase if one manages to avoid further alterations within three months. 

Each phase also doubles the power’s potency without counting towards the phase’s alteration threshold, this increase in power is permanent. 

The fifth phase, Volatile Surge, is repeated for each subsequent alteration after the fifth if it falls within the three month period, becoming increasingly unstable and chaotic the more alterations there are. 

The effects of each phase, except for Volatile Surge, can be partially mitigated with rigorous and focused training, but only by managing to get to a lower phase or out of the phases can the drawbacks be completely eliminated. 

If one manages to drop to a lower phase or out of the phase entirely you can improve upon their power again. In the same manner, allowing you to continuously improve their abilities. 

Be warned however that shard powers can be burned out by this, as the shard will need to reveal more and more power to its host, and potentially burn an incredible amount of energy to create new features. 

This drawback is removed if you are Negentropic/Shardless, and will allow you to use your own energy source to make their improvements and/or share the secret to Negentropy with their power source if you wish.

title: (Mover/Shaker) Nexus
description_html: A core aspect of the Entities' cycle is the distribution of their shards across a vast number of alternate universes. Thanks to shards' inherent multi-dimensional nature, despite being physically spread out on alternate worlds, they're also present and linked within a semi-virtual dimension called the 'Shardspace'. This dimension acts as a network in which shards can directly communicate and interact with the hosts they are connected to along with other shards. Your shard is vital to the Entities, being solely centred around the construction, maintenance and operation of this Shardspace. From this, you have gained the power to access an alternate version of this Shardspace. Your version of this dimension is completely empty with no shards present and has effectively nigh-infinite size. You possess a full mental awareness of everything that occurs within this dimension. You can permanently warp space inside the dimension to a certain extent, allowing you to manipulate the distances between objects and locations or adjust gravity in specific areas to walk upside-down, for example. The passage of time within this dimension is also completely separate from that of real space and you can modify it as you wish, either rapidly accelerating time in this dimension or slowing it. Thanks to its semi-virtual nature, you have full control over the landscape and environment of this dimension although it must possess the same basic conditions needed to support life as that on Earth. You cannot create sentient life. You could potentially construct huge cities, create forests that cover planets and support the existence of entire civilisations within this dimension. The real strength of this power lies in its ability to act as a connecting dimension across the multiverse; you can use this dimension and open portals from it to access almost any place within your shard's range limit such as alternate universes and other dimensions. You can open portals of any size and shape from real space to this dimension and vice versa as you wish. Due to its semi-virtual nature, transporting large amounts of energy or matter that was created in this dimension into real space will cause your shard to run out of energy as it attempts to substitute for it. Selecting Negentropy or Shardless negates this possibility. description_plain:
A core aspect of the Entities' cycle is the distribution of their shards across a vast number of alternate universes. Thanks to shards' inherent multi-dimensional nature, despite being physically spread out on alternate worlds, they're also present and linked within a semi-virtual dimension called the 'Shardspace'. This dimension acts as a network in which shards can directly communicate and interact with the hosts they are connected to along with other shards.

Your shard is vital to the Entities, being solely centred around the construction, maintenance and operation of this Shardspace. From this, you have gained the power to access an alternate version of this Shardspace. Your version of this dimension is completely empty with no shards present and has effectively nigh-infinite size. You possess a full mental awareness of everything that occurs within this dimension.

You can permanently warp space inside the dimension to a certain extent, allowing you to manipulate the distances between objects and locations or adjust gravity in specific areas to walk upside-down, for example. The passage of time within this dimension is also completely separate from that of real space and you can modify it as you wish, either rapidly accelerating time in this dimension or slowing it.

Thanks to its semi-virtual nature, you have full control over the landscape and environment of this dimension although it must possess the same basic conditions needed to support life as that on Earth. You cannot create sentient life. You could potentially construct huge cities, create forests that cover planets and support the existence of entire civilisations within this dimension.

The real strength of this power lies in its ability to act as a connecting dimension across the multiverse; you can use this dimension and open portals from it to access almost any place within your shard's range limit such as alternate universes and other dimensions. You can open portals of any size and shape from real space to this dimension and vice versa as you wish. Due to its semi-virtual nature, transporting large amounts of energy or matter that was created in this dimension into real space will cause your shard to run out of energy as it attempts to substitute for it. Selecting Negentropy or Shardless negates this possibility.

This power even allows you to open portals into typically blocked-off worlds and dimensions from interdimensional travel such as worlds which host a shard's main body as well as the Shardspace dimensions used by Entities and their shards to communicate, including your own Shardspace. This means you could potentially interact with your own Shard directly as well as others. Note that an Entity's home dimension containing its core shards is still inaccessible to you without a direct link to it.

This dimension possesses strong safeguards to block interdimensional intrusions from outsiders, preventing unwanted access. While this is sufficient to block normal shards and Endbringers, Entities can quickly break through its barriers after some effort.

addons.title: Shard Landscaping
addons.description_html:
Much like the environment and landscape within the Shardscape, you have complete control over the shards now present in this dimension. You can reshape and restructure them according to your vision. These shards can transform into cities, forests, or even celestial bodies, depending on their size. Any changes you make to their structures will not affect their inherent abilities and powers.

Shards can temporarily join together to exchange information and data. When you connect a shard to one in use, it will also passively improve their powers by receiving the shared information. However, the more shards that merge in this way, the diminishing the improvement in their powers will be.

Within this realm, the power of a shard can influence every aspect of it. Depending on its powers, it can transform the environment into a hostile barrier against intruders, safeguard and oversee the dimension, and alter the bodies and minds of those who enter the shardspace. This influence can also extend to you in a limited capacity: shards can monitor your presence, protect you by teleporting you to safety within the Shardspace at the hint of danger, or even teleport your enemies close to you to be confronted. This may lead to your shards quickly running out of energy if you use too much of their powers unless you possess Negentropy.

You have two methods for creating new shards from the existing ones in the space. The first method involves combining shards to form a single, larger shard that inherits all the abilities of the original shards. However, merging powerful or large shards can be challenging and risky; if not executed carefully, you might destroy all the shards involved. Additionally, the power of the resulting shard might exceed the capacity of the intended slot.

The second method involves "budding" new shards from existing ones, resulting in a shard with a variant of the original powers. For instance, if one shard controls earth and another creates limbs, the new shard might generate limbs made of earth. The power of the newly budded shard will be a random combination of the two original powers, averaged to half the strength of the combined abilities. Additionally, the original shards will be reduced to 20% of their strength for 24 hours.

As time passes and you gain experience, you'll discover new and powerful ways to utilize your shards in this space.

title: (Thinker/Trump) Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Firmament
description_html:
Do you know there’s a place where Shards roost and establish themselves the moment they connect with their [Hosts]? You sure do, your Shard spilled the beans the moment it reached out, a peek of the plane where the magic happens. 

Your Shard has arranged your connection to the Firmament as part of your power’s parameters: You get mental access to the Firmament every time you consciously request it, appearing almost immediately over your Island to embody your connection between you and your Agent. The Firmament is a semi-virtual space composed of a multiversal lattice, where the sightseeing attractions are your fellow Parahumans and their respective Islands.

At first, you possess no abilities outside of checking your connection with your Passenger and the settings thereof, such as your awareness of personal power parameters and expressions, and your semi-immortality derived from your Shard’s memory banks, being fashioned a “body” from the vitreous substance of your Island the moment you “enter”. A biological respawn, so to speak.

The more you cultivate and attune your bond with your Shard, though, you set a personal foothold for more overt functionalities allowed by your Shard: your access grows to be fully physical, freely managing your Connection without being involved in directly operating the [Data] or [Basis] of your powers, and merge with your Shard-Avatar for more applications.

Merging with your Shard grants a mix between [Query][Response] and Power Sight modulated for your comprehension (your Shard translating for you) while on Shardspace. You’ll perceive any Shard Communication as how we usually communicate, being more natural to your sensibilities, with any [Data] or [Broadcast] being partly decoded for your understanding with sufficient context on where to place a dialogue, such as other Shard’s designations, hosts, and roles in the [Cycle]. 

(Still, There are limits: you can’t influence or use your Shard’s received or historical [Data] for personal use unless you convince it otherwise).

Shardspace Access and Shard Merging is only merely the tip of the iceberg: for what’s an Island without an Ocean? Once you reach the pinnacle of your connection you come to be a “gateway” for your Shard’s Island, overlapping between Shardspace and Realspace, partially or fully materializing into the untamed sea that is reality. 

Partially materializing your Island causes surrounding matter to transmute into raw Shardmatter you can manipulate and make use of as a raw resource for both personal and parahuman use: piggybacking from it to enhance your Shard’s connection for a stronger bandwidth and ending up with a more potent power expression while temporary, or directly manipulate it to ensnare or trap any unlucky cape, easily tuning in their Shard.

(This pairs quite well with Connection, Override, Manager, Gestation or any other Shard power fully utilizing Shard Manipulation.) 

Fully materializing your Island brings it forth as it has always been: a full representation of your Shard’s domain of influence, rank, and specialization blending with your mental landscape, representing your connection with your Shard Avatar looming over, ever watchful. Any Parahumans close by will find a light cognitohazardous effect by directly gazing at your Shard Avatar, they aren’t supposed to know or be aware of [Cycle] secrets, after all.

This full manifestation offers Shard Merging applied to Realspace, truly unleashing your Shard’s full expanse from the possible power expressions you could’ve gained from different possibilities, and a freedom of [Data] collection from nearby Parahumans, akin to a temporary Ascension. Retaining your Partial Materialization abilities will always be in store.

Lastly, if you go as far as attacking an Island and succeed in damaging it, it reflects on the Host through glitches in their power, broken power expressions, or even potential fatal brain damage.

addons.title: [Expanse]
addons.description_html:
[CONNECTION]

[LINK]

[EXPANSE]

Your Shard’s added functionalities to Shardspace—both Island and Nexus—synchronize and blur between one another, your Shard almost becoming hazy within Shardspace as it starts to transform into Nexus’ bridge into proper Shardspace, able to relocate and shift between both. This has several consequences, such as being able to manipulate your Island's surrounding environment and physics as it extends Nexus’s fine manipulation to itself, being enhanced once you merge with your Shard or fully Materialize it. Partially Materializing isn’t left unscathed, your fine control of Shardspace expanding as far as your Shardmatter and extending your sphere of influence to a full Trump aspect, where if a Parahuman is in the proximity of a Shardmatter-infested area is then analyzed, their Shard located for later use. Once touched or attacked, then, they’re irreversibly transformed into Shardmatter, almost like a hungering infection into the real world, forcibly Triggering dormant Parahumans with portals to your Island growing by the infection. Fully Materializing goes into an Absolute Territory, using both Hitchhiker and Nexus’ capabilities to impose a large section of Shardspace into the real world, with this area caged from local reality. This area takes Shard-like qualities, and, in time, all Parahumans’ Connections are brought to your [Domain] open for the taking. Another outcome on Nexus’ side is that your bridge between both semi-virtual spaces redefines it; it becomes the “shadow” Shardspace casts, any change made in Shardspace is reflected onto Nexus, and vice versa. This redefinition helps in triangulating all Shards’ (and their Connections) “location”, able to be invaded and promptly under your control, growing into a node where your abilities are channeled, but only if you achieve a fully realized Connection. But be careful of quickly expending all of your [Energy]. Fully Manifesting for a long time is a taxing event for your Shard’s life, in this case.

addons.title: Interdiction’s Brochure of Iridescent Sights
addons.description_html:
Tapping into the unfiltered lifeblood of Shardspace brings about the full potential of Materialization.

Your Partial Materialization and Full Materialization of your Shard fully manipulates and converts any matter and energy into Shardmatter and Shardspace’s energy signature, generating a dimensional field ruled by Shardspace’s rules. This field gives an iridescent crimson glare to the area, mirages alluding to Shardspace. In return, shaping Shardmatter is freeform, emulating structures and technology being powered by your energy, to the point of sculpting pseudo-Shards capable of imitating Shard architecture temporarily, that may act as relays or minions. 

Fully manifesting your Shard Avatar will encroach on Realspace to accommodate your Avatar by fully expanding your dimensional field to enclose an area comparable to a city, with the field fully at your control with Interdiction’s abilities.

addons.title: Flashpoint
addons.description_html:
A turning point occurred between your connection with your Shard’s Island and Keystone’s Network, reaching a boiling point.

Normally, Keystone’s main functionality revolves around moderating and optimizing the members’ Shards within your Network, but Hitchhiker will inevitably take it a step further. Now, the Shardscape Simulation is no more, the Shards from you and your members finding a solution; long live the Insular Mass, made from the Island of your members’ Shards with you at the center, integrating Hitchhiker’s abilities to your Keystone. Your Insular Mass takes charge of your past Shardspace Simulation you once had, while at the same time being the collective energy reservoir for all your members.

With your Insular Mass acting as both the resource for your items and energy all at once, the items you and your members create are composed of raw Shardmatter you mold into the shape of mundane equipment, acting the part. Charging up now is a steady affair, where all members can lower or raise the amount of power they wish, and the amount of power expressions it can manifest, going up to 10-20 20 SP highly synergizable power expressions they can develop using their Shard’s available [Data], while also removing the limitation of charging up one item at a time.

Aside from benefiting from Hitchhiker’s powers, your members have a greater say in your Network: when they are in need of a buff, their Shard will establish an internal ping within your Insular Mass, and in response, your Shard will arrange [Resources] and [Energy] back to theirs to strengthen their “bandwidth” in their Connection for a steady, permanent “buff”. Influencing Keystone’s functionalities at a deeper level, linking your items together, and the energy and power sharing/transference between members is now democratized, where all the items’ powers are pinged among members at all times due to your closer connection, while giving the option of opting up select powers how they see fit. 

Adding to that, when an item either breaks or burns out, your Insular Mass works as an anchor, recalling the item back into your collective resources. This extensive energy expenditure overclocks your Insular Mass, which lowers restrictions regarding Endbringers and Entities, making the items able to contend with the likes of an unrestricted Endbringer or Entity’s Avatar for a few days.

Your Insular Mass takes charge of your past Shardspace Simulation you once had, while at the same time being the collective energy reservoir for all your members.

addons.text:
[CONNECTION]

[LINK]

[EXPANSE]

Your Shard’s added functionalities to Shardspace—both Island and Nexus—synchronize and blur between one another, your Shard almost becoming hazy within Shardspace as it starts to transform into Nexus’ bridge into proper Shardspace, able to relocate and shift between both. This has several consequences, such as being able to manipulate your Island's surrounding environment and physics as it extends Nexus’s fine manipulation to itself, being enhanced once you merge with your Shard or fully Materialize it. Partially Materializing isn’t left unscathed, your fine control of Shardspace expanding as far as your Shardmatter and extending your sphere of influence to a full Trump aspect, where if a Parahuman is in the proximity of a Shardmatter-infested area is then analyzed, their Shard located for later use. Once touched or attacked, then, they’re irreversibly transformed into Shardmatter, almost like a hungering infection into the real world, forcibly Triggering dormant Parahumans with portals to your Island growing by the infection. Fully Materializing goes into an Absolute Territory, using both Hitchhiker and Nexus’ capabilities to impose a large section of Shardspace into the real world, with this area caged from local reality. This area takes Shard-like qualities, and, in time, all Parahumans’ Connections are brought to your [Domain] open for the taking. Another outcome on Nexus’ side is that your bridge between both semi-virtual spaces redefines it; it becomes the “shadow” Shardspace casts, any change made in Shardspace is reflected onto Nexus, and vice versa. This redefinition helps in triangulating all Shards’ (and their Connections) “location”, able to be invaded and promptly under your control, growing into a node where your abilities are channeled, but only if you achieve a fully realized Connection. But be careful of quickly expending all of your [Energy]. Fully Manifesting for a long time is a taxing event for your Shard’s life, in this case.
addons.title: [Expanse]

addons.text:
Tapping into the unfiltered lifeblood of Shardspace brings about the full potential of Materialization.

Your Partial Materialization and Full Materialization of your Shard fully manipulates and converts any matter and energy into Shardmatter and Shardspace’s energy signature, generating a dimensional field ruled by Shardspace’s rules. This field gives an iridescent crimson glare to the area, mirages alluding to Shardspace. In return, shaping Shardmatter is freeform, emulating structures and technology being powered by your energy, to the point of sculpting pseudo-Shards capable of imitating Shard architecture temporarily, that may act as relays or minions. 

Fully manifesting your Shard Avatar will encroach on Realspace to accommodate your Avatar by fully expanding your dimensional field to enclose an area comparable to a city, with the field fully at your control with Interdiction’s abilities.

raw_object_text_safe.text:
Do you know there’s a place where Shards roost and establish themselves the moment they connect with their [Hosts]? You sure do, your Shard spilled the beans the moment it reached out, a peek of the plane where the magic happens. 

Your Shard has arranged your connection to the Firmament as part of your power’s parameters: You get mental access to the Firmament every time you consciously request it, appearing almost immediately over your Island to embody your connection between you and your Agent. The Firmament is a semi-virtual space composed of a multiversal lattice, where the sightseeing attractions are your fellow Parahumans and their respective Islands.

At first, you possess no abilities outside of checking your connection with your Passenger and the settings thereof, such as your awareness of personal power parameters and expressions, and your semi-immortality derived from your Shard’s memory banks, being fashioned a “body” from the vitreous substance of your Island the moment you “enter”. A biological respawn, so to speak.

The more you cultivate and attune your bond with your Shard, though, you set a personal foothold for more overt functionalities allowed by your Shard: your access grows to be fully physical, freely managing your Connection without being involved in directly operating the [Data] or [Basis] of your powers, and merge with your Shard-Avatar for more applications.

Merging with your Shard grants a mix between [Query][Response] and Power Sight modulated for your comprehension (your Shard translating for you) while on Shardspace. You’ll perceive any Shard Communication as how we usually communicate, being more natural to your sensibilities, with any [Data] or [Broadcast] being partly decoded for your understanding with sufficient context on where to place a dialogue, such as other Shard’s designations, hosts, and roles in the [Cycle]. 

(Still, There are limits: you can’t influence or use your Shard’s received or historical [Data] for personal use unless you convince it otherwise).

Shardspace Access and Shard Merging is only merely the tip of the iceberg: for what’s an Island without an Ocean? Once you reach the pinnacle of your connection you come to be a “gateway” for your Shard’s Island, overlapping between Shardspace and Realspace, partially or fully materializing into the untamed sea that is reality. 

Partially materializing your Island causes surrounding matter to transmute into raw Shardmatter you can manipulate and make use of as a raw resource for both personal and parahuman use: piggybacking from it to enhance your Shard’s connection for a stronger bandwidth and ending up with a more potent power expression while temporary, or directly manipulate it to ensnare or trap any unlucky cape, easily tuning in their Shard.

(This pairs quite well with Connection, Override, Manager, Gestation or any other Shard power fully utilizing Shard Manipulation.) 

Fully materializing your Island brings it forth as it has always been: a full representation of your Shard’s domain of influence, rank, and specialization blending with your mental landscape, representing your connection with your Shard Avatar looming over, ever watchful. Any Parahumans close by will find a light cognitohazardous effect by directly gazing at your Shard Avatar, they aren’t supposed to know or be aware of [Cycle] secrets, after all.

This full manifestation offers Shard Merging applied to Realspace, truly unleashing your Shard’s full expanse from the possible power expressions you could’ve gained from different possibilities, and a freedom of [Data] collection from nearby Parahumans, akin to a temporary Ascension. Retaining your Partial Materialization abilities will always be in store.

Lastly, if you go as far as attacking an Island and succeed in damaging it, it reflects on the Host through glitches in their power, broken power expressions, or even potential fatal brain damage.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Thinker/Trump) Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Firmament

title: (Master/Trump) Endbringer Engine
description_html:
To the inhabitants of Earth Bet, you have been given perhaps the most terrifying power to exist—the power to create Endbringers.

However, while you possess the power to create Endbringers, the power is not quite as potent as its most notable user.

Thus, you have been given the ability to create completely loyal monsters that start weaker than their brothers and sisters. Each Endbringer you create will start with a core and enough spatial and dimensional folding energy to create the standard folding spatial flesh that all Endbringers use to protect their cores.

These weaker Endbringers will start with roughly 30 SP worth of power and can handle a couple of strikes from their fully grown brothers and sisters, but not much more.

They will then improve over time, growing bigger, stronger, and more durable at the rate of roughly 1 SP a month until they are fully grown and can match the strength of Behemoth and Leviathan (roughly 60 SP). You have complete control over the abilities they spawn with and how they will evolve.

A fully grown Endbringer may be given any group of Shard-based powers that total 60 SP and is not a power-granting or power-growing ability. Any power selected can be scaled up or down according to its chosen SP, so long as the total of all powers given to an Endbringer does not exceed 60 SP. Esoteric Knowledge allows an Endbringer to be given non-shard-based powers.

However, the construction of each Endbringer is extremely energy and processing-intensive, meaning that, while you start with an available slot, only 1 additional (or replacement) Endbringer can be made every month (can be reduced to a week with Negentropy) and only 7 can be alive at the same time. Also, if you spawn too many Endbringers in total without Negentropy, you run the risk of completely depleting your Shard.

addons.description_html:
Your cores' innate ability to empower one another has built upon itself, harmonizing and empowering itself.

You can now reassign your and your Endbringers' cores as you wish, with each core drastically empowered by the power of the one who possesses it. You can reassign the cores to either yourself or your Endbringers in any combination.

You may also choose to fuse cores, tripling the effect per core but likewise reducing the number of cores they have available and making them more vulnerable.

addons.description_html:
Your ability to summon Endbringers has been further enhanced by the shear scale of energy you now produce through your cores. Now, not only can you freely transfer cores and energy between your Endbringers but all of your Endbringers are now summoned fully grown. 

To make matters worse for your enemies, outside of just fusing with your Endbringers, you can now freely transfer the abilities of your Endbringers between cores (including your own), allowing you to swap abilities between Endbringers and between Endbringers and yourself should their cores still exist. 

Be mindful that fusing cores still produces a tripling of energy production but comes at the cost of reducing the amount of cores that are available and making you and your Endbringers more vulnerable.

title: (Changer/Trump) Intra
description_html:
You have complete and absolute control of yourself. And I do mean complete, down to the molecular level. This grants you a multitude of benefits, one of them being an absolute immunity to outside influences on your body, including master effects, biological manipulation, and even molecular disintegration. This absolute control of your body means that you can fashion yourself into a living weapon; anything is possible, from making your skin as durable as if it were part of an Endbringer to reinforcing your muscle filaments to be so strong that they could easily contend with the strongest Brutes, rewriting the neural pathways of your brain so that they work better than most thinker-based abilities by sheer processing power. All of that and more, from growing wings to transmuting your blood properties to be as or even far more toxic than even the greatest Tinkertech poisons. Speaking of which, you now also possess the ability to completely heal yourself through consciously closing wounds (if you ever are injured).

But that pales in comparison to your ultimate ability: the capability to make additional Corona Pollentias. Now on its own, there is nothing to gawk about; then again, your command over your body allows you to flood the Pollentia with the stress hormones that a Shard would normally use for Crisis Points and establish connections, allowing you to gain more powers (from different Shards) and even direct it so you gain specific power classifications: Shaker, Master, Blaster, among others. There is a limit to how much power you can gain before they start to negatively affect you, though, being around 3 to 5. However, you can also easily get rid of a power by simply removing the Gemma and Pollentia responsible for said power.

<small>Note: Your absolute control over yourself renders attacks such as Stilling nearly completely useless; however, less esoteric attacks are completely effective. Also, your bodily functions (circulatory, respiratory, lymphatic, etc.) still need to be maintained for you to stay alive; despite that, you can do it manually or change the way they function freely.</small>

You have complete and absolute control of yourself. And I do mean complete, down to the molecular level. This grants you a multitude of benefits, one of them being an absolute immunity to outside influences on your body, including master effects, biological manipulation, and even molecular disintegration. This absolute control of your body means that you can fashion yourself into a living weapon; anything is possible, from making your skin as durable as if it were part of an Endbringer to reinforcing your muscle filaments to be so strong that they could easily contend with the strongest Brutes, rewriting the neural pathways of your brain so that they work better than most thinker-based abilities by sheer processing power. All of that and more, from growing wings to transmuting your blood properties to be as or even far more toxic than even the greatest Tinkertech poisons. Speaking of which, you now also possess the ability to completely heal yourself through consciously closing wounds (if you ever are injured).

But that pales in comparison to your ultimate ability: the capability to make additional Corona Pollentias. Now on its own, there is nothing to gawk about; then again, your command over your body allows you to flood the Pollentia with the stress hormones that a Shard would normally use for Crisis Points and establish connections, allowing you to gain more powers (from different Shards) and even direct it so you gain specific power classifications: Shaker, Master, Blaster, among others. There is a limit to how much power you can gain before they start to negatively affect you, though, being around 3 to 5. However, you can also easily get rid of a power by simply removing the Gemma and Pollentia responsible for said power.

Also, your bodily functions (circulatory, respiratory, lymphatic, etc.) still need to be maintained for you to stay alive; despite that, you can do it manually or change the way they function freely.</small>

Perfection: Elemental Dragon allows you to become Wind, Water and Electricity. You can only be one of those elements at a time. Intuition: Second Chance allows you to set up a point in time where you can return to every time you use this power again. This portal cannot be bigger than 3 meters. You can only have one portal at a time. You can make the portal suck anything close to one side to bring to the other side. Passion: Genesis allows you to create objects by drawing on air a 3D white outline of them. While the outline itself needs to roughly conform with the object, the size doesn't need to be the same. The object doesn't need to be created right on the exact place you drawed its outline, it just needs to be in the same direction. You can create anything mundane without the necessary knowledge of how they are made, and can create anything beyond the mundane as long as you have the knowledge to do so or you have powers that you could engrave on rhe object at the time of its creation, like arrows that can apply Cataclysm on whatever they hit. Power Nullifiers can unmake those objects. Derision: Uproar allows you to create a orange orb that causes the power of the target hit to temporarily be disrupted and malfunction, lasting 5 minutes. In order to hit the target with it you need to physically throw it. You can only have two orbs at a time, though once you hit someone with it you can create a new one. Pretension: Sublimation allows you to have any single power up to 10 SP. Those powers are fragile and may stop working with usage, needing to be summoned again. Adoration: Fetch allows you to create balls you would typically use to play with dogs, hitting an object with it applies a tag, which you can use to teleport it to you. Jubilation: Gift can be used in two ways, through eye contact and through touch. Through eye contact you can temporarily substitute someone's senses with something they desire. Through touch you can trap someone on a endless dream where their desires are granted, the only way for them to wake up is through outside interference or by them reality its all a dream. The touch version warps the sense of time of the targeted, a few seconds of real life would be decades of living in the dream.

title: (Stranger/Breaker) Informatio
description_html:
You are attuned to the essence of information—no, more than that, you are information incarnate. Every byte, every whispered word, every pixel in an image that pertains to you forms a vast network, a web of existence you navigate with ease. You live within these threads, making homes out of the records and memories of your existence. Your awareness extends to the whispers of your name, the trace of your image, and the mere idea of you. The essence of who you are resides in the data scattered throughout the world, and this makes you more than a mere being—you are a living, breathing entity woven into the very fabric of knowledge itself.

Your understanding of the world comes from the information it holds. When it concerns you directly, you possess complete and intimate knowledge—nothing is hidden, nothing is obscure. A mention in a conversation, a line in a database, a photograph on a screen, or a memory in someone’s mind—all these are extensions of yourself. If someone mentions you, you feel it like a vibration in the web that makes up your consciousness. Their words become another anchor point, another node in the expansive network of your existence.

The extent of your awareness is more nuanced than mere omniscience. While you have a complete understanding of information directly tied to you, your sense stretches beyond to include anything tangentially related. If you are blonde, you gain a faint, yet undeniable, awareness of every other blonde individual in the world. Their lives do not unfurl before you as an open book, but their presence is a hum, a flicker in your perception. It’s like standing in a crowded room where only certain voices rise above the din—you hear their whispers, sense their existence, but the details are vague unless you focus your attention. You are bound by threads that extend beyond the self, connecting to the broader world in a web of faintly glowing lines.

This power allows you to move through these connections, appearing anywhere where information about you resides. A rumor passed between lips, a photograph pinned to a wall, a digital footprint in a remote server—each of these points becomes a doorway. You do not travel through space as others do; instead, you fold reality along the lines of information. Where your name is thought of or your likeness is stored, you may manifest, a living ghost moving through the data streams of the world. To those who witness such appearances, it is as though you slip through the cracks of reality, emerging from the shadow of a mention or the reflection of a thought.

Beyond movement, you wield the power to manipulate the very essence of information. Information itself is malleable to you, like a sculptor shaping clay. You can destroy it, leaving a void where it once was. When you choose to destroy information, you can induce a Stranger effect, erasing the traces of that knowledge from reality. People forget details, files become corrupted, and memories fade. The information is removed; however, this doesn’t change what already happened, simply altering known history to make it that whatever information you destroyed never existed. The absence you create is more than a hole in memory; it is a shift to accommodate the new narrative you impose. It’s important to note that you do not warp Information in the sense of altering history itself; rather, you manipulate the knowledge and memories of others, subtly adjusting their perceptions so that they align with the narrative you create. 

Your nature as living information means you are not bound by a singular identity. You can graft new information into your very being, shaping yourself according to the knowledge you possess. If you decide to adopt the information that you are a ginger, then you gain the same semi-awareness of all gingers as if this trait had always been yours. Your awareness extends to those who share that characteristic, creating a faint hum in your perception of every ginger person in existence. In the same way, you can graft other aspects—traits, experiences, skills, even entire histories—transforming yourself with each new piece of information you integrate.

However, you are limited by the physical reality you inhabit. You cannot hold contradictory truths within yourself simultaneously; if you are currently a ginger, you cannot also be blonde at the same time. But this limitation doesn’t bind you entirely. Instead of discarding contradictions, you store them within a mental vault, like files archived for later use. You can switch between these traits, activating or deactivating them as needed. If a situation requires you to adopt a different appearance or characteristic, you can draw upon the stored information, effectively rewriting your own existence. To the outside world, this change is seamless—people perceive you as if you had always been this way, with reality subtly adjusting around the new narrative.

This means that while your external appearance or traits may shift, others will not notice any inconsistency. They will remember you as a blonde if that is what you choose to be, even if you had been a ginger the moment before. Photographs, memories, and even written records will warp to align with your current state, ensuring a complete integration into the fabric of reality. You can shift from being a seasoned warrior to a charming socialite, and the world will remember you accordingly. It’s as if the very history around you is rewritten to match your current self, smoothing over any discrepancies.

Your ability to graft information is not limited to physical traits. Skills, experiences, and even personal relationships can be absorbed into your being, becoming a part of your new self. You could integrate the combat techniques of a master martial artist, the scientific knowledge of a renowned researcher, or the memories of a seasoned traveler. These aspects become part of your identity until you choose to store them away, allowing you to seamlessly adapt to different roles and challenges. When you assume the knowledge or skills of another, it feels as though you’ve always possessed them, your body moving with the instinctual ease of long-practiced motions.

You have no fixed form, no unchanging nature. Instead, you are defined by the sum of the information you have chosen to integrate and the echoes of all the selves you have stored. This makes you as fluid and adaptable as the information that defines you, always changing, always evolving, yet anchored in the awareness of every aspect that has ever been part of your existence.

In a sense, you are both a storyteller and the story itself—reshaping the narrative of who you are and what you can be, bending reality to match your chosen role. Those who encounter you might think they know you, but that knowledge is always subject to change, always malleable. You walk through the world as a living enigma, a presence that is both ever-shifting and eternally present, defined by the information you hold and the secrets you choose to become.

Your understanding of the world comes from the information it holds. When it concerns you directly, you possess complete and intimate knowledge—nothing is hidden, nothing is obscure. A mention in a conversation, a line in a database, a photograph on a screen, or a memory in someone’s mind—all these are extensions of yourself. If someone mentions you, you feel it like a vibration in the web that makes up your consciousness. Their words become another anchor point, another node in the expansive network of your existence.

The extent of your awareness is more nuanced than mere omniscience. While you have a complete understanding of information directly tied to you, your sense stretches beyond to include anything tangentially related. If you are blonde, you gain a faint, yet undeniable, awareness of every other blonde individual in the world. Their lives do not unfurl before you as an open book, but their presence is a hum, a flicker in your perception. It’s like standing in a crowded room where only certain voices rise above the din—you hear their whispers, sense their existence, but the details are vague unless you focus your attention. You are bound by threads that extend beyond the self, connecting to the broader world in a web of faintly glowing lines.

This power allows you to move through these connections, appearing anywhere where information about you resides. A rumor passed between lips, a photograph pinned to a wall, a digital footprint in a remote server—each of these points becomes a doorway. You do not travel through space as others do; instead, you fold reality along the lines of information. Where your name is thought of or your likeness is stored, you may manifest, a living ghost moving through the data streams of the world. To those who witness such appearances, it is as though you slip through the cracks of reality, emerging from the shadow of a mention or the reflection of a thought.

Beyond movement, you wield the power to manipulate the very essence of information. Information itself is malleable to you, like a sculptor shaping clay. You can destroy it, leaving a void where it once was. When you choose to destroy information, you can induce a Stranger effect, erasing the traces of that knowledge from reality. People forget details, files become corrupted, and memories fade. The information is removed; however, this doesn’t change what already happened, simply altering known history to make it that whatever information you destroyed never existed. The absence you create is more than a hole in memory; it is a shift to accommodate the new narrative you impose. It’s important to note that you do not warp Information in the sense of altering history itself; rather, you manipulate the knowledge and memories of others, subtly adjusting their perceptions so that they align with the narrative you create.

Your awareness extends to those who share that characteristic, creating a faint hum in your perception of every ginger person in existence. In the same way, you can graft other aspects—traits, experiences, skills, even entire histories—transforming yourself with each new piece of information you integrate.

However, you are limited by the physical reality you inhabit. You cannot hold contradictory truths within yourself simultaneously; if you are currently a ginger, you cannot also be blonde at the same time. But this limitation doesn’t bind you entirely. Instead of discarding contradictions, you store them within a mental vault, like files archived for later use. You can switch between these traits, activating or deactivating them as needed. If a situation requires you to adopt a different appearance or characteristic, you can draw upon the stored information, effectively rewriting your own existence. They will remember you as a blonde if that is what you choose to be, even if you had been a ginger the moment before. You can shift from being a seasoned warrior to a charming socialite, and the world will remember you accordingly. It’s as if the very history around you is rewritten to match your current self, smoothing over any discrepancies.

Your ability to graft information is not limited to physical traits. Skills, experiences, and even personal relationships can be absorbed into your being, becoming a part of your new self. You could integrate the combat techniques of a master martial artist, the scientific knowledge of a renowned researcher, or the memories of a seasoned traveler. These aspects become part of your identity until you choose to store them away, allowing you to seamlessly adapt to different roles and challenges. When you assume the knowledge or skills of another, it feels as though you’ve always possessed them, your body moving with the instinctual ease of long-practiced motions.

You have no fixed form, no unchanging nature. Instead, you are defined by the sum of the information you have chosen to integrate and the echoes of all the selves you have stored. This makes you as fluid and adaptable as the information that defines you, always changing, always evolving, yet anchored in the awareness of every aspect that has ever been part of your existence.

In a sense, you are both a storyteller and the story itself—reshaping the narrative of who you are and what you can be, bending reality to match your chosen role. Those who encounter you might think they know you, but that knowledge is always subject to change, always malleable. You walk through the world as a living enigma, a presence that is both ever-shifting and eternally present, defined by the information you hold and the secrets you choose to become.
