title: (Shaker/Thinker) Cheat Shard Engine
description_html:
Your Shard has a specialized role within the network: monitoring every conceivable variable it can detect. This ranges from the distance between two Shards, the number of atoms in a planet, quantum fluctuations over time, and even the exact wavelengths of various effects. Your Shard has complete access to the data observed by all Shards on the network, allowing it to perceive space, time, matter, energy, information, digital space, consciousness, technology, more—and crucially, to alter those variables. This means you can fine-tune, search, amplify, or even freeze specific parameters at will.

Your ability to control these variables manifests in various ways. For example, you could ensure a cup is always half full, regardless of how much liquid is added or removed. You could fix the distance between objects or prevent atoms from moving, freezing their electrons in place despite external forces like electromagnetic fields, gravity, or chemical reactions.

Your Shard's vast observational capability can be overwhelming. Initially designed to function independently, it was not optimized for use by a [HOST]. As a result, your field of vision is sometimes cluttered with overlapping data that may seem nonsensical. However, you can focus this abstracted information by concentrating on specific objects. At low levels of abstraction, you’ll perceive familiar concepts such as vectors, temperature, spatial coordinates, rigidity, and hardness. At higher levels of abstraction, you’ll see more complex information: atomic numbers, relative positions of objects, radiation signatures, and covalent bonds. At the highest abstraction, you’ll access phenomena like the Cosmic Microwave Background, quantum foam, and even inter-universal relations. The downside is that unless you're skilled at multitasking, you can only focus on one variable at a time, and it takes a moment to interpret what you're seeing.
 
When targeting a Parahuman, your power automatically "zooms in" on their Shard, providing essential data such as Shard-Host distance, power bandwidth, and wormhole metrics on the corona. You can adjust, amplify, or stabilize these variables—or even lock them to specific values. By manipulating the "think and do stuff" variable in their Corona, you can temporarily shut down their powers, holding this effect until you release it.

Additionally, you can locate the Shard's resting Earth, disconnect it from the Network, or reconnect it if desired. Beyond individual powers, you can impact Shards on a broader scale: "fix" Case 53s, reconnect dormant Shards to Zion's network, or supply energy to a Shard by modifying its "Total Energy" variable.

You can also manipulate physical reality—creating a miniature, self-sustaining star, forming a singularity that doesn’t pull matter, or binding atoms to simulate nuclear pasta's unbreakable density. On a smaller scale, you could keep a bank account balance permanently fixed, set surface friction to zero, turn diamond into a truly unbreakable material, make plastic a superconductor, or freeze your phone battery at 1%.

addons.title: Conceptual Abstractionism
addons.description_html:
Cheat Shard Engine has subsumed your ability to copy and wield more conceptual properties, teaching itself how to manipulate more abstract and contextual variables and even doing away with the stamina and concentration requirements and your need for initial physical contact to copy and affect properties. Additionally, the intuitiveness of Proprietor of Properties extends to Cheat Shard Engine as well, making its usage easier and more intuitive.

This allows for an even wider variety of effects, such as amplifying someone’s charisma, lowering an object’s ’durability’ to make it easier to harm, applying the concept of ‘explosivity’ to something to turn it into a bomb, etc. To you, the world is merely a collection of traits and variables for you to manipulate as you see fit.

title: (Master/Trump) Drawing Board
description_html:
You can create and summon life. Your power allows you to create characters and companions with a wide variety of histories and powers. You can summon them through your will and imagination alone, or you may use a medium for a boost.

Each day, you gain 10 charges (15 if you’re Shardless/Negentropic). You can use a single charge to create a character(s)/creature(s) that’s roughly on par with a normal human.

This can be a single creature or a group of creatures, although their combined power/danger level will be roughly the same as a single creation.

By spending more charges, whether during its creation or after, you can enhance its abilities and powers, widening its repertoire of abilities and enhancing its existing capabilities.

A single charge will allow you to grant them an ability that’s roughly a 3 on the PRT scale, with 2 charges needed to increase its rating by 1, to a maximum rating of 10 on the PRT scale for a single ability. They can hold up to 6 powers at the start and will be able to hold one additional ability with every month that passes after their initial creation. There is no limit to what kind of ability you can give them.

You can also spend a charge to grant them near superhuman skill in a specific skill; there is no limit to how many skills you can do for a single creation.

Their abilities can synergize and benefit from other factors, such as other trump abilities you possess, without it counting towards their limit on the charge improvements.

You can create and summon characters/creatures using nothing more than your will, but by utilizing mediums, the cost of producing them is significantly lessened, depending on their quality and type used. The medium is not destroyed or altered if used; it simply exists as a reference point for your power.

You may also spend a charge to rework them, altering/reshaping them into something else, although it will not increase their power by doing so, serving more as a rewrite of them than an improvement.

Poorly drawn images in crayon may yield almost no benefit, but a realistic 2D drawing could let you summon a version that’s already mildly superhuman and with one or two low-level powers with a single charge. A 3D sculpture could yield a much more powerful creation, even potentially granting it extra space for abilities or increasing the limit on how many charges you can use on them.

You do not need to create the media/medium; you may use existing ones to summon them, including the use of the creations of others for this. When using existing media as a reference, you can choose to alter it as you wish, so it’s not a 1:1 copy, if at all, using it simply as a reference for appearance, personality, and/or powers.

Regardless of what personality you give them, they’ll be intrinsically loyal to you, although you may find some interesting interpretations of commands depending on personality.

Alongside your ability to pull from books, you may now expend a charge to create items.

A single charge can net you an item worth roughly 6 CP or an item worth roughly 3 SP. More charges will grant greater and more powerful items, similar to your characters.

You can rewrite items at will, reshaping them into something else. Items have 6 slots (9 if Shardless/Negentropic) that can house abilities. As a result of the dimension of your power, you gain twice as many charges as before.

When creating objects, characters, or creatures, you gain a boost the more well-known they are. A character from a short story published at a local school by one of their students and liked and known by their classmates may have the character created a little more powerful and more skilled than they would be otherwise. A worldwide known and beloved character of a decade-old series could be summoned near, if not at their full strength, with a single charge.

This is based on the popularity and renown at the time you are creating/summoning them. The more your character is altered from the source material, the less effective the boost is.

addons.title: Author Fiat
addons.description_html:
You can now grant your creations Perks and personal Drawbacks. It takes a single charge to grant them a single Perk or Drawback. A drawback can be removed by expending a charge.

You can use this to give your creations perks and drawbacks that you do not have, although their own versions will have a hole in their defense against you and your abilities. This can be waived if it would benefit you or if you simply would like it, although it can be reinstated at will.

addons.title: Legion of the Drawn
addons.description_html: You have merged the fantastical with the tactical. Each member of your Personal Army now manifests a superpower upon being summoned. You choose the type of power each unit receives—whether pyrokinesis, teleportation, or something stranger—but you do not control its strength. Instead, each soldier rolls for their power level at the moment of creation, producing a distribution centered around PRT rating 5. Most will average between PRT 4 and 6, with a smaller portion reaching higher levels. Roughly 5% will land between PRT 7 and 8, while 1% may attain PRT 9 or even 10. The powers granted to your troops automatically integrate with the technology and skills they are given, allowing for synergistic combinations of gear and ability. A teleporting grenadier might blink behind enemy lines, while a forcefield generator could serve as a mobile shield wall for an entire squad. Every soldier’s equipment and abilities are seamlessly optimized to work in unison. In addition, you may spend a charge from Drawing Board to make an individual from your legion permanent. Doing so removes them from the Multiversal Legion troop limit, causing a new soldier to be randomly generated in their place, and allows you to upgrade, personalize, or grant skills to the permanent individual at the same rate and to the same extent as any other Drawing Board creation. You can also use a single charge to grant a specific human-level skill to an entire squad, or to reroll a squad’s powers entirely.

addons.text:
You can incorporate a history for your characters, allowing you to weave them into the world’s history instead of simply creating them from scratch.

This could have potentially wide-reaching implications, letting you retroactively build an army.
addons.title: Huh Isn’t That

addons.text: Instead of simply creating from scratch, you can now call upon your Isekai power in reverse, capable of summoning characters/creatures the same way you would have sent them elsewhere. This allows you to summon creatures and characters as if they were sent by Isekai, although you can control whether this is a true summoning or whether it’s simply a background your power constructs for them. Whether summoning characters in a specific form of media or simply allowing your power to summon at random, it’ll summon someone that perfectly aligns with you, regardless. You can be as broad, specific, and vague as you wish. You must expend a charge to summon, and you are no longer limited to how many abilities you can grant or how far you can improve them.
addons.title: Reverse Isekai

raw_object_text_safe.text:
You can create and summon life. Your power allows you to create characters and companions with a wide variety of histories and powers. You can summon them through your will and imagination alone, or you may use a medium for a boost.

Each day, you gain 10 charges (15 if you’re Shardless/Negentropic). You can use a single charge to create a character(s)/creature(s) that’s roughly on par with a normal human.

This can be a single creature or a group of creatures, although their combined power/danger level will be roughly the same as a single creation.

By spending more charges, whether during its creation or after, you can enhance its abilities and powers, widening its repertoire of abilities and enhancing its existing capabilities.

A single charge will allow you to grant them an ability that’s roughly a 3 on the PRT scale, with 2 charges needed to increase its rating by 1, to a maximum rating of 10 on the PRT scale for a single ability. They can hold up to 6 powers at the start and will be able to hold one additional ability with every month that passes after their initial creation. There is no limit to what kind of ability you can give them.

You can also spend a charge to grant them near superhuman skill in a specific skill; there is no limit to how many skills you can do for a single creation.

Their abilities can synergize and benefit from other factors, such as other trump abilities you possess, without it counting towards their limit on the charge improvements.

You can create and summon characters/creatures using nothing more than your will, but by utilizing mediums, the cost of producing them is significantly lessened, depending on their quality and type used. The medium is not destroyed or altered if used; it simply exists as a reference point for your power.

You may also spend a charge to rework them, altering/reshaping them into something else, although it will not increase their power by doing so, serving more as a rewrite of them than an improvement.

Poorly drawn images in crayon may yield almost no benefit, but a realistic 2D drawing could let you summon a version that’s already mildly superhuman and with one or two low-level powers with a single charge. A 3D sculpture could yield a much more powerful creation, even potentially granting it extra space for abilities or increasing the limit on how many charges you can use on them.

You do not need to create the media/medium; you may use existing ones to summon them, including the use of the creations of others for this. When using existing media as a reference, you can choose to alter it as you wish, so it’s not a 1:1 copy, if at all, using it simply as a reference for appearance, personality, and/or powers.

Regardless of what personality you give them, they’ll be intrinsically loyal to you, although you may find some interesting interpretations of commands depending on personality.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Master/Trump) Drawing Board

title: (Mover/Shaker) Displacement
description_html: You have become the quintessential example of what is often called a ‘Blink’ Mover, a sub-classification centred solely around teleportation, thanks to your shard’s focus on the shifting and transportation of space. You can employ two distinct types of spatial teleportation. The first is a two-way ‘swapping’ teleportation in which two areas, along with any matter and energy within, are switched in location. The second is one-way teleportation; this effectively erases any matter and energy in the receiving area, replacing it with the incoming space, while creating a vacuum in the original location. For example, you could teleport away a section of air, leaving a vacuum, with that section of air then erasing and overlaying anything at the destination. This power has no specific range limitations, aside from standard shard constraints, allowing you to remotely teleport space around the world and even across dimensions. You do, however, have a limited total spatial volume of what you can teleport at once, equivalent to that of a sphere 1 km in radius. Within this limit, you can freely decide the dimensions of the space you wish to teleport and can teleport numerous separate areas simultaneously, though you are limited by your multitasking and overall maximum volume. This power is not Manton Limited and acts as an All-or-Nothing effect, capable of spatially cutting matter on an atomic level. While it can affect Endbringer flesh, Endbringer cores remain immune due to their safeguards and spatial warping properties. This power automatically accounts for and compensates for factors like momentum, planetary rotational velocity, energy transfer, etc. To aid in its use, you possess a secondary thinker ability that grants you conscious spatial awareness of everything in the area that you want to teleport from as well as the area that you wish to teleport to, though you need a clear mental image of both locations involved. This clairvoyant sense can even remotely scout out areas you have a clear awareness of. Finally, this ability also provides excellent innate finesse, fine enough that you can teleport complex 3-dimensional shapes, like cutting out a keyhole from a wall.

addons.title: Chronal Displacement
addons.description_html: The spatial-temporal aspects of Epoch’s power — such as transporting objects to their positions up to ten seconds from the past or future and temporarily freezing them — have seamlessly integrated. You can now employ these more time-oriented spatial manipulations with the same range, volumetric area and precision as (Mover/Shaker) Displacement, significantly expanding your versatility. For example, you could teleport huge droves of enemies back to their positions from 10 seconds earlier or, to avoid imminent attacks, remotely teleport them to where they will be located up to 10 seconds in the future. You can also temporarily freeze vast sections of space at will, up to that of your maximum volume and a ten-second time limit. Do note that maintaining this stasis is a continuous use of your total spatial volume capacity.

addons.title: Dimensional Trekker
addons.description_html: Your spatial and dimensional manipulation powers have merged into a cohesive whole. With (Shaker/Mover) Dimension Tripper, you can now transport large sections of space you are aware of from halfway across the world into dimensions and universes of your design. This ability also works in reverse, enabling you to teleport sections from your dimensions into the current universe. For example, you could teleport a region of space from a dimension where gravity is 100 times stronger or the ground is diamond. Be mindful, however, that areas of space from dimensions significantly different from the universe it is in will dissipate as the universe reasserts itself. The greater the divergence in fundamental laws, the faster the dissipation. To complement this, your control over your teleported spaces has improved. You can "phase" these spaces, regulating how "real" they are within the current universe and preventing them from fully overlapping existing matter. This enables you to precisely manage interactions between the two overlapping spaces, ensuring only the desired effects manifest. For instance, you could phase a dimension where machinery does not function over enemy tech. You can also use this to purposely hold areas from other dimensions out of sync to prevent dissipation. Note that maintaining this "phasing" requires continuous mental focus.

title: (Trump) Another
description_html:
You can one time per week create a white pocket watch-like object called Record. A Record can engrave in itself the story of a Parahuman, their past, present, and future. By pressing its button you can insert the Record on someone, allowing them to become an Another—a distorted version of the recorded Parahuman. A Record is nigh-indestructible, the only way to destroy it is through the Parahuman they recorded, either through their powers or identity.

The engraving can be done in three ways. The first method is by being in the presence of the Parahuman. The second method is by being in the presence of something affected/made by their power. Finally, the final method is being present in a location significant to their story.

Whenever the power of the recorded Parahuman is used it will be weakened, if the power is completely gone then history alters itself so that their cape identity is erased from existence and only their civilian identity remains, with anything they did as a cape being attributed to others. But this alteration isn't 100% reliable, echoes of their existence remain, and some people might have vague memories while others remember them outright.

An Another is separated into two Transformations. The first is based on the civilian identity of the Parahuman, while the second is based on their cape identity, meanwhile, the Another can only be one at a time they can easily transition from one to the other. Those transformations are distorted, having physical mutations reminiscent of Case-53s and often incorporating elements from significant parts of the story of the Parahuman, like their allies and enemies, the way they died, etc. The cape transformation is much more monstrous than the civilian one. The civilian transformation has the name of Parahuman and the year of their trigger engraved in it, while the cape transformation has their cape name and the year of its creation engraved in it.

The transformations are accompanied by transitions based on their powers, like bursting into flames and dissipating to reveal the transformation. Transforming into the cape identity causes those nearby to hear the name of the Parahuman that originated that Another.

If an Another uses their transformations too frequently or for too long—with both at the same time accelerating the consequences—, they will start to have their mind slowly merged with a distorted mirror of the mind of Parahuman, with that mind eventually having a greater focus. While normally the merging could be undone by not transforming for a time, once the distorted mind becomes the focus the only way to undo the merge is by the record being destroyed. What is meant by "distorted mirror" is that mirrors appear to invert something yet do not quite do so, that's what happens with the mind of an Another, for example, a kind Parahuman results in an Another that is cruel by being kind.

Anothers have a slightly stronger manifestation of the power of the original. These variations will often incorporate elements from the significant parts of the recorded story. With time new powers based on the story are acquired and the existing powers gradually increase in strength through effort and use.

The civilian transformation has everything enhanced to the human limit, while the cape transformation is 3x that. Anothers can only be killed using the powers or identity of the recorded Parahuman—they aren't just revived though, they are reset back to peak condition, meaning that any fatigue acquired in battle (or possible damage to their powers) is removed—, thought when that happens the record will be broken instead of the Ex-Another dying.

A Record is nigh-indestructible, the only way to destroy it is through the Parahuman they recorded, either through their powers or identity.

The engraving can be done in three ways. The first method is by being in the presence of the Parahuman. The second method is by being in the presence of something affected/made by their power. Finally, the final method is being present in a location significant to their story.

Whenever the power of the recorded Parahuman is used it will be weakened, if the power is completely gone then history alters itself so that their cape identity is erased from existence and only their civilian identity remains, with anything they did as a cape being attributed to others. But this alteration isn't 100% reliable, echoes of their existence remain, and some people might have vague memories while others remember them outright.

An Another is separated into two Transformations. The first is based on the civilian identity of the Parahuman, while the second is based on their cape identity, meanwhile, the Another can only be one at a time they can easily transition from one to the other. Those transformations are distorted, having physical mutations reminiscent of Case-53s and often incorporating elements from significant parts of the story of the Parahuman, like their allies and enemies, the way they died, etc. The cape transformation is much more monstrous than the civilian one. The civilian transformation has the name of Parahuman and the year of their trigger engraved in it, while the cape transformation has their cape name and the year of its creation engraved in it.

The transformations are accompanied by transitions based on their powers, like bursting into flames and dissipating to reveal the transformation. Transforming into the cape identity causes those nearby to hear the name of the Parahuman that originated that Another.

If an Another uses their transformations too frequently or for too long—with both at the same time accelerating the consequences—, they will start to have their mind slowly merged with a distorted mirror of the mind of Parahuman, with that mind eventually having a greater focus. While normally the merging could be undone by not transforming for a time, once the distorted mind becomes the focus the only way to undo the merge is by the record being destroyed. What is meant by "distorted mirror" is that mirrors appear to invert something yet do not quite do so, that's what happens with the mind of an Another, for example, a kind Parahuman results in an Another that is cruel by being kind.

Anothers have a slightly stronger manifestation of the power of the original. These variations will often incorporate elements from the significant parts of the recorded story. With time new powers based on the story are acquired and the existing powers gradually increase in strength through effort and use.

The civilian transformation has everything enhanced to the human limit, while the cape transformation is 3x that. Anothers can only be killed using the powers or identity of the recorded Parahuman—they aren't just revived though, they are reset back to peak condition, meaning that any fatigue acquired in battle (or possible damage to their powers) is removed—, thought when that happens the record will be broken instead of the Ex-Another dying.

title: (Shaker) Providence
description_html: You’ve gained access to the most efficient energy collection system the Entities have ever created. You’ve gained the ability to create and manipulate virtual particles, brief and transient particles arising from the vacuum. Your control over this power is incredibly limited but immensely potent. This power comes with 3 main abilities. First is the ability to create virtual particles, which must always come in pairs, within a massive radius of 20 kilometers. Whenever you create particles, they will immediately entangle and interact with one another to erase each other out of existence. This is where the potential lies, for virtual particles that normally come into existence right next to each other immediately obliterate. You can control where and when they manifest, as well as be able to untangle their existence from their pair. The second ability is that you can create a sort of virtual space, a crinkle in space-time where matter and energy cannot enter normally, where you can manifest one side of the virtual particles. What this means is that while you can freely summon virtual particles in real space, you can force them to interact with other forces, resulting in unique effects. For example, by summoning one virtual particle in real space and another in your virtual space, they can no longer interact with each other, effectively creating new energy in your virtual space, which your shard can collect for itself. As the universe must correct the imbalance in energy, this results in the virtual particles in real space becoming negative energy, which will instead obliterate whatever it interacts with, bringing the system that is the universe back into balance. The reverse can also be done, where instead of allowing virtual particles to sit in the virtual space alone and incapable of interacting with others and in turn unable to obliterate themselves and forcing them to become real, you can feed energy from your shard into the virtual space, allowing it to obliterate itself, but in turn, forcing its pair in real space to become real, effectively transmuting energy at an almost perfect conversion rate, the only loss of energy for your shard being the energy needed to start the reaction. You also possess the ability to manipulate virtual pairs in the same space, allowing you to freely alter the allocation of energy and matter throughout your range as well as control interactions between particles. Your shard will archive any matter and energy you and your power interact with, effectively building a catalogue of types of energy and matter it can transmute energy into. This catalogue will quickly expand, allowing you to be able to construct anything you desire with some time, which itself is incredibly intuitive once you know what you want to create. Because of the nature of these interactions, you have no theoretical limit to how much energy can be introduced to a system, although it’ll still retain equilibrium at the end of the interaction. The energy cost your shard has for the interaction is static for each interaction, regardless of the amount transmuted; all it needs to do is kickstart the interaction. This can be devastating if not wielded carefully; even a single kilogram of matter being transmuted to pure energy can result in catastrophic damage. Collected energy can flow to improve any ability you possess.

title: (Trump/Stranger) Persona
description_html:
You have 3 slots for which you design and store Personas.

Personas are different forms you can design, whose appearance, powers, equipment, skills, and even personalities are under your control.

Personas can be designed freely and have a budget of either 15 SP or double the total SP of your other powers combined, whichever is greater, for which you can design your powers.

Skills and equipment are also subject to this budget, with simple clothes or costumes not costing any part of your budget, but equipment and/or skills that go beyond the scope of your base form are calculated into your total budget.

A Persona's physical forms are entirely under your control—whether tall, short, muscular, a different sex, or any other variations one can think of. Likewise, a Persona’s personality and mind are also entirely under the purview of this power, not merely a facade, but able to adopt the mentality in full while wearing it.

You may adorn a Persona stored in one of your slots at any time, taking on their form, abilities, and personality at will, and you can hot swap between any of your stored Personas.

A Persona takes 1 day to form inside a slot after you design it. After its design, you may make minor alterations to it, such as minor cosmetic alterations or small tweaks to its powers. You cannot make fast, wide-sweeping changes to a Persona after its creation, but minor tweaks over time can drastically alter it over time.

You can drop a Persona at will to free up a slot to design another, following the same time requirements as before. You may also call up old Personas by following the same process as creating a new one.

You have a set of secondary Thinker abilities that help you design and tweak Personas inside your mind, allowing you to instinctively and effortlessly craft them down to the most minute and perfect detail and tweak them as needed, and that allows you to remember every Persona designed and any alterations made.

If you die while wearing a Persona, you’ll automatically be swapped to another available Persona, or your normal form if all of them have been destroyed. A damaged or destroyed Persona takes twelve hours to regenerate back to full. Swapping between Personas will clean the Personas unless you intentionally hold this aspect back.

addons.title: Author Insert
addons.description_html: You can choose to design your Personas by using Drawing Board as a vector. You maintain your normal budget; however, you can now include Drawing Board's ability to create, enhance, and alter your Personas, and Drawing Board can now treat your Personas as if they were a normal creation of it. You can choose to speed up your Persona creation process by foregoing the normal allotted budget, relying entirely on Drawing Board to create the Persona as it would a character, but this, in turn, allows you the possibility of creating a Persona instantly by paying the cost. If a Persona lasts in a slot for at least a month continuously, you may spend a single charge from Drawing Board to move it from your slot to make it into its own creation, although it’ll clear your slot.

addons.title: Triumvirate
addons.description_html: You can now summon your unused Personas as minions independent of you. You can freely communicate with each other and see through their senses, tap into their memories instantly, and coordinate flawlessly. Alongside being able to swap between Personas at will, you can swap where you are between the Personas that are active without swapping their locations or recalling them, able to effectively swap bodies between active Personas. This automatically happens if the Persona you are inhabiting is destroyed and there is an active one available.

addons.title: Luga
addons.description_html:
You can use your Manager Slots to create and develop Personas as you would under Personas Slots, and you can store, hold, and manipulate Personas as you would normal powers.

This massively enhances your ability to tweak and alter your Personas at will, able to rewrite them entirely on a moment's notice.

You can also use Manager to hand off Personas to others. When doing so, you can choose one of two methods: one is by granting it to them as a Persona, allowing them to mantle the Persona as you normally would, or you can choose to allow the Persona to take over the person, effectively rewriting them into the Persona themselves.

addons.description_html:
You can create Personas that your shades can take the form of. You may store as many Personas as you wish among your shades, although you are still limited by how many shades you can normally summon, and this does not affect your ability to summon and store Personas for your own personal use.

You may create Personas in your slots as normal, but instead of discarding them, you may choose to place them among your shades. While you can place Personas among your Shades and use them as Shades, you cannot move them back using this method.

addons.title: A Thousand Faces
addons.description_html:
Each of the thousands of souls inside your mind has their own distinct Persona Slots available to them, same as you. This grants you a much greater arsenal to potentially draw from. They have as many Persona slots as you do, and each of their slots is as powerful as your own.

They will usually have at least one persona slot filled with a persona that they use to represent themselves. While you can draw upon any of these Persona slots as you would your own, the Persona slots themselves are created and maintained by their respective owners, and as such, they may create a wide variety of personas that you yourself may not have thought of or drawn up.

While you can converse with and ask your personalities to create specific Personas, they’re not beholden to it and can create whatever they wish with their own slots. While you don’t have direct control over the personas they create, you will still be as aware of them and their abilities, personalities, and quirks as you would be of your own.

You can use your Manager Slots to create and develop Personas as you would under Personas Slots, and you can store, hold, and manipulate Personas as you would normal powers.

This massively enhances your ability to tweak and alter your Personas at will, able to rewrite them entirely on a moment's notice.

You can also use Manager to hand off Personas to others. When doing so, you can choose one of two methods: one is by granting it to them as a Persona, allowing them to mantle the Persona as you normally would, or you can choose to allow the Persona to take over the person, effectively rewriting them into the Persona themselves.
addons.title: Luga

addons.text:
You can create Personas that your shades can take the form of. You may store as many Personas as you wish among your shades, although you are still limited by how many shades you can normally summon, and this does not affect your ability to summon and store Personas for your own personal use.

You may create Personas in your slots as normal, but instead of discarding them, you may choose to place them among your shades. While you can place Personas among your Shades and use them as Shades, you cannot move them back using this method.
addons.title: Gwydion

addons.text: Each Sensory you make through Character Creation will now be automatically added as a Persona after the ten years have passed. Those Personas do not count toward your slot limit, allowing you to accumulate an entire library of faces given enough time. Moreover, the limit of power for each new Sensory is now the same as for the creation of a Persona.
addons.title: Alt-form

addons.text: You can now construct your clones as you would your Personas, with all the benefits and advantages that Hive Mind and Persona would entail. Personas created in this way are not saved in your slots, although their template is remembered as normal if you wish to do so. Personas created in this manner are not restricted by the normal time frame required to manifest as they would in your slots, instead utilizing Hive Mind’s construction for its manifestation.
addons.title: I Am Legion

addons.text:
Each of the thousands of souls inside your mind has their own distinct Persona Slots available to them, same as you. This grants you a much greater arsenal to potentially draw from. They have as many Persona slots as you do, and each of their slots is as powerful as your own.

They will usually have at least one persona slot filled with a persona that they use to represent themselves. While you can draw upon any of these Persona slots as you would your own, the Persona slots themselves are created and maintained by their respective owners, and as such, they may create a wide variety of personas that you yourself may not have thought of or drawn up.

While you can converse with and ask your personalities to create specific Personas, they’re not beholden to it and can create whatever they wish with their own slots. While you don’t have direct control over the personas they create, you will still be as aware of them and their abilities, personalities, and quirks as you would be of your own.
addons.title: A Thousand Faces

raw_object_text_safe.text:
You have 3 slots for which you design and store Personas.

Personas are different forms you can design, whose appearance, powers, equipment, skills, and even personalities are under your control.

Personas can be designed freely and have a budget of either 15 SP or double the total SP of your other powers combined, whichever is greater, for which you can design your powers.

Skills and equipment are also subject to this budget, with simple clothes or costumes not costing any part of your budget, but equipment and/or skills that go beyond the scope of your base form are calculated into your total budget.

A Persona's physical forms are entirely under your control—whether tall, short, muscular, a different sex, or any other variations one can think of. Likewise, a Persona’s personality and mind are also entirely under the purview of this power, not merely a facade, but able to adopt the mentality in full while wearing it.

You may adorn a Persona stored in one of your slots at any time, taking on their form, abilities, and personality at will, and you can hot swap between any of your stored Personas.

A Persona takes 1 day to form inside a slot after you design it. After its design, you may make minor alterations to it, such as minor cosmetic alterations or small tweaks to its powers. You cannot make fast, wide-sweeping changes to a Persona after its creation, but minor tweaks over time can drastically alter it over time.

You can drop a Persona at will to free up a slot to design another, following the same time requirements as before. You may also call up old Personas by following the same process as creating a new one.

You have a set of secondary Thinker abilities that help you design and tweak Personas inside your mind, allowing you to instinctively and effortlessly craft them down to the most minute and perfect detail and tweak them as needed, and that allows you to remember every Persona designed and any alterations made.

If you die while wearing a Persona, you’ll automatically be swapped to another available Persona, or your normal form if all of them have been destroyed. A damaged or destroyed Persona takes twelve hours to regenerate back to full. Swapping between Personas will clean the Personas unless you intentionally hold this aspect back.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Trump/Stranger) Persona

title: (Thinker/Changer) Storyboard
description_html: You are like a photon, for you, no time has passed since you received this power. From the beginning to the end, you observe and experience the entirety of your personal timeline all at once. This is not a prison; you are free to act, change your actions, and react in different ways to change your personal timeline from within. Obviously, changing one thing in your personal timeline will change everything past that point. The end of your personal timeline is when you die. Unlike most Thinker powers, this bypasses or even ignores most blind spots, such as Triggers, Endbringers, or Entities, because unlike traditional Thinker powers, you are actively experiencing the information firsthand. This also provides a form of immortality because if you die, you can just change your actions earlier in your personal timeline to avoid that death. When you aren’t actively concentrating on a part of your personal timeline, that version of you will be able to slightly mentally distance themselves from the rest of your personal timeline to live in the moment. This lets the rest of your mind focus on the parts of the timeline you want without having to worry about every little detail. You may also, at any time, transform your body, taking on any conditions or forms your body has previously taken before that point in your personal timeline. Without Negentropy, the maximum length your timeline can reach is 300 years.

title: (Brute/Breaker) Undying
description_html:
Your Brute power is… peculiar in how it applies itself. Following the thought experiment of Quantum Immortality, your power ensures you’ll be the version among your alternate or parallel selves that survives every life-or-death scenario and continues living even through absurdity and apparent impossibility.

In a nutshell, throughout every possibility due to quantum necessity imposed by your Shard infringing on the laws of the universe more than they usually do, you’ll be the variant that survives till the end of the [Cycle] (or till the end of time itself if you picked Negentropy or Shardless) with both the methods and reason growing continually more absurd or impossible the more your quantum possibilities grow all the more preposterous, including ridiculous measures of survival when no other avenue of survival is possible—not eating that one food with a parasite to narrowly avoiding being hit by a car and being resurrected by a power interaction between Alabaster and Scapegoat coincidentally within your corpse’s vicinity.

title: (Breaker/Blaster) Biological Dynamo
description_html:
You’ve gained the ability to convert matter into energy, store it, and manipulate and utilize stored energy to enhance yourself.

Your body’s biological processes related to consumption and energy use are completely altered. Whenever you consume food, water, air, sunlight, or any other form of sustenance, your power converts the material into pure energy at a 1:1 rate and stores it. As a result of this perfect conversion, you produce no waste of any kind.

Your body’s functions are powered and enhanced by the stored energy. Highly optimized and efficient, your body bypasses many normal processes, delivering energy directly where needed—enhancing muscle strength, accelerating healing, replacing the need for oxygen, and even boosting cognitive function. You suffer none of the typical drawbacks: you can use full strength without damaging your muscles, heal rapidly without reducing your lifespan, and operate far beyond human limits without harm.

You can also project and manipulate this stored energy from any point on your body, transforming it into kinetic, electric, thermal, or other forms. This enables you to emit blasts of heat, generate kinetic force to fly, and more. Your body remains in peak condition, constantly refined by your power, converting all excess or waste energy into usable form.

Your physical and mental structure naturally adapts to handle your energy levels, preventing any backlash from your power use. You instinctively grasp and control your energy perfectly. Additionally, you possess a secondary thinker ability that lets you intuitively know how much energy you have left and how to use it with maximum efficiency. This energy can also be converted to fuel and enhance any of your other powers.

addons.title: Golden Dynamo
addons.description_html:
Your Golden Form and your ability to manipulate energy interact in a new, interesting way.

Your Golden Form now passively fills your energy stores even when not active, enough so that your normal form will grant as much energy as your Golden Form would normally possess if you didn’t have Biological Dynamo.

As would be normal whenever you enter your Golden Form, you have access to much greater stores of energy, far surpassing whatever you would have collected.

However, this is where things start to differ a bit—whereas Golden Form would have normally acted as merely an amplifier, now it also acts as a power plant. Your Golden Form will passively fill your stores of energy up until it matches whatever your greatest volume of stored power was, and then continue after that at a scaling pace.

This will slowly increase your greatest volume, which will, in turn, allow more and more power to be brought to bear in your Golden Form as it continues to scale alongside your normal form.

Your control over your energy is greatly enhanced as well, now able to freely transmute your Golden Form’s form and energy into any form of energy you could control and back, as well as granting Golden Form’s innate control over your energy manipulation ability.

Your store of power can be refilled from empty to full in 24 hours by Golden Form’s passive generation. As your Greatest Stored Volume increases, the energy generation will scale to match alongside it so that it’ll keep refilling at the same pace.

addons.title: Bottomless Well
addons.description_html: You would think that the secret behind a species' fantastical abilities that outclass anything humans could do would ultimately come down to a more efficient energy collection system—whether they collect more energy from food by having a different process, or they collect energy in massive quantities from somewhere else. But it’s not always the case, Ki being a perfect example. Its unique supernatural features allow an otherwise unremarkable being to reach unimaginable heights with it, enhancing them to levels that seem absurd at best. You, however, are remarkable. Rather than simply supplementing one another, your Ki responds to your powerful body and energy. As your store of energy grows, your Ki will interact with it, multiplying and fusing alongside it. Your power will treat your Ki reserves and enhancements as if they were scaled equivalently with a normal human. So if your Ki had grown to the point that you can level mountains as a normal human ordinarily, your Biological Dynamo-influenced body will, in turn, be that much more powerful, even if your store of Ki would otherwise generate a much less remarkable level of power. This also extends to any other power and/or energy sources that enhance you.

addons.title: Erasure Engine
addons.description_html:
Your energy collection is no longer limited to your bodily processes; instead, you’re able to collect energy as you would normally through your Providence power to fuel yourself.

Moreover, you can now wield energy and matter more effectively, able to generate and transmute it into its various forms with barely any effort, practically responding to your will rather than thoughts, and you are no longer limited to projecting and manipulating it from your body—instead, you're able to do it anywhere within range.

Perhaps most importantly, however, is that you can now freely wield negative energy, which erases whatever it hits. Negative energy effectively works at a minimal energy cost to you, as its energy cost is almost entirely compensated by the erasure of any matter and energy it touches. Negative mass and energy will erase any of its positive counterparts it interacts with, and will disrupt almost any power it comes into contact with.

title: (Shaker/Trump) World Builder
description_html:
You’ve gained the ability to potentially construct entire worlds. From nothing more than your mind, you can sculpt and create spaces where new realms operate, with life and rules that defy reality. You can create them through your will and imagination alone, or you may use a medium for a boost.

Each day, you gain 10 charges (15 if you’re Shardless/Negentropic). You can use a single charge to create a space with a volume of 5 million cubic feet. You may design the space as you wish, whether as a sphere, a cube, etc.

Each additional charge multiplies the volume by 10. Inside this space, you may have it replicate and maintain any environment you’ve been in and replicate and maintain the laws of physics and other metaphysical properties of any world you have encountered in the past without any further cost.

This can allow you to have flowing rivers of clean and fresh water flowing from one end of the space, where there is no possible source, to having a small forest that gathers sunlight from light that comes from above that does not come from a star to a sky that shows stars when there are none. This space will perfectly replicate these phenomena as if they were coming from outside sources, if necessary to fulfil its purpose.

Once created, the shape and composition of the space are set, and further charges are needed to rewrite it into different spaces. You can have the space you construct be inhabited by life, from simple microbes to complex flora and fauna. Inside the space, you can alter the rules of reality into something new.

A single charge allows you to imbue the space with a property that, when shaped into a Parahuman power, would be roughly equal to 10 SP. Each charge after that increases the effect by 2 SP. You have 8 slots to assign properties or effects to each space, with an additional slot being added every month after creation. This can be things such as gentle flowing rivers of water that heal all ailments of those that drink from it and heal all injuries of those that bathe in it, to schools that permanently grant a power to all that attend it, etc.

You can also spend a single charge to grant the property a supernaturally enhanced mundane property (such as absolute silence, perfect temperature, unbreakable walls), with no limit to how many such enhancements you can bestow on a single space.

For the life in your spaces, you can add as much mundane life as you wish, as well as any kind of life that you encounter outside normally. For sentient creatures, you can add/create a single member of a sentient species for a single charge. Every charge after that will allow you to increase that population by an order of magnitude for the same species.

While you do not have in-depth control over the population or its members, they are intrinsically loyal and are affected by the properties of the space. You can control the overall affinities and behaviors of the population in a broad sense, such as making them more naturally warlike or more aligned with engineering, etc. A single charge is required for an affinity or broad-scale control.

The population you create may be adults, but they are still newborns. You can make the civilization older by spending additional charges, the first charge granting the population a single year, every charge multiplying it by 10. Depending on how many charges you pour into it, this can allow the space to have its own history, civilizations, etc.

You may create and summon spaces using nothing but your will, but utilizing a medium—such as a detailed map, a diorama, or an architectural model—greatly reduces the cost, depending on the quality and detail of the medium. The medium remains unharmed and serves only as a reference point for your power.

You may use existing media, including works created by others, as inspiration or a template for your spaces, and you can freely alter any details to suit your vision. The reference can be used for appearance, layout, atmosphere, and/or the fantastical properties you wish to include.

You may also spend a single charge to rework or reshape an existing space into something entirely new, although this will not enhance the overall power of the spaces, only allowing you to rewrite and adapt them.

Spaces are naturally separate dimensions—to access these spaces, you can create portals to and from your dimensions from wherever you are, as well as create permanent portals and locations that can be used to access these spaces. Things inside your dimension can also exit through these portals.

You can link your separate spaces at will, linking unlike dimensions with one another. You may also combine separate dimensions as long as each of the dimensions is at least a month old, their total volumes combine, and their total slots also combine, but they will still only continue to accrue one additional slot a month.

While these spaces are separate dimensions, you can also spend 5 charges to instead override an existing location or space in the real world to be the target of your power instead.

The effects of the spaces can be used to synergize and amplify powers and effects, both yours and others' in the spaces.

addons.title: Has That Always Been There?
addons.description_html:
With your power, you can retroactively add your changes to a space, allowing you to potentially create entire new histories, cities, etc.

Whereas you might have drawn a lot of questioning eyes if a village of superpowered soldiers popped up out of nowhere, now you can have it so that no one so much as bats an eye, the whole thing old news and part of the established status quo as far as everyone is concerned.

title: (Mover) Run Barry, Run
description_html:
You can run fast—so fast that perception can no longer track you, not even by sight, sound, or enhanced senses. To anyone else, your movement is a gap, a blurless skip in causality itself. You don’t appear to move—you simply vanish from one place and reappear in another, leaving observers struggling to understand the space between. You run this fast by covering absurd distances with every step, leaping across cities in just a few strides, the entire process taking less than 0.001 seconds. These vast strides are supported by your total detachment from terrain—you can run across water, lava, vertical walls, ceilings, or clouds by intuitively making contact to keep pushing off something. You no longer require “ground” in any traditional sense.

Each stride births a concussive shockwave strong enough to level buildings or scatter crowds like paper in a gale. You can dial this force in or out, adjusting the raw kinetic violence of your wake depending on whether you intend to shatter a battlefield or pass like a ghost. Similarly, the sheer friction and momentum of your run allow you to carve through the world—footsteps that cleave pavement, shear stone, and rip trenches into the earth. At your peak, your speed begins to wear against space itself. Running doesn’t just shake the air—it causes gravitational distortions or minor spatial warping.

But the true edge of your power lies in its relentlessness. Once you begin running, your body sustains itself in motion. You don’t tire and don’t need rest, food, or breath. Every step fuels the next in an unbroken kinetic loop, and so long as your feet keep moving, you are self-contained.

title: (Master/Trump) Sovereign
description_html:
You’ve gained the ability to Master and empower others.

Within a 1km radius surrounding yourself, you have an internal sense of all living things, which serves as a targeting system for your power to empower them.

Within your activation radius, you can immediately trigger anyone, granting them abilities as if they had naturally triggered, matching their psyche, trauma profile, potential, and taking other factors into account.

Those who were already primed to trigger or close to it receive dramatically more powerful abilities. Regardless of their state, all empowered subjects are at least comparable to the average cape, with a few outliers capable of matching top-tier capes.

Those you empower fall fully under your thrall, their loyalty unshakable and their minds seamlessly connected to yours.

Through this flawless mental link, you maintain perfect coordination of their movements, powers, and even their thoughts, no matter how many follow you or how far they roam — once bound, there is no distance limit on your control.

You know every detail of their abilities, every weakness, every strength, and you can coordinate and command them with flawless precision and coordination.

You also possess the ability to empower those under your thrall by loosening your mental grip, dramatically increasing their power in exchange for granting them more freedom. The less control you keep, the more their abilities grow, potentially reaching monstrous scales.

However, this process is irreversible — once you grant them that freedom, you cannot take it back, and they may one day turn those newfound liberties against you.

With every subject you empower, your awareness expands: you sense their locations, their conditions, their intentions, and their loyalty, managing them all as a perfect, unified legion.

You possess a secondary Thinker power designed to give infinite multitasking and awareness of your subjects and all that entails them, able to do all of this with no strain on you.

addons.title: Divine Right
addons.description_html:
You can now take over existing Parahumans within your activation range, as well as through touch, either through you or through one of your subjects, even outside your activation range.

You no longer need to permanently give up control, or any at all, to empower your subjects. With control over their Shards, you can command the Shard and empower your subjects with the full breadth of their power without giving up control.

Instead, you can willingly give up any control you’d like and/or regain it at will. You can even hide this from your subjects, leaving them completely unaware as to how comprehensive your control is or isn’t.

You can even set it to simply an unbreakable and unshakable loyalty and loosen all other restrictions if you’d like, allowing you wholly independent but loyal subjects to make things simple for yourself.

Rather than an active control, you can have it set to work subconsciously; you are always aware and working in concert alongside it and with yourself, or take direct control over it.

With control over the Shards, you can control connections, reconnect Shards with other subjects and even yourself, alter expressions of powers, and even retain control over the shards even if your subject dies, the Shard is as under your domain as your subjects are.

Your control over a Shard is permanent is as permanent as your control over your subjects and cannot be broken unwillingly.

You are no longer limited or required to empower your subject into Parahumans to take control; your power extends to all life that has crossed into your activation range.

You can extend your domain quietly, able to ensnare all within your range and leave them unchanged, only to reveal it much later.

You can choose to empower your subjects later on if you delay empowering them.

You no longer need to give up control to empower others, able to heighten the ability of others without drawback.

You can choose to empower your subjects later on if you delay empowering them.

You no longer need to give up control to empower others, able to heighten the ability of others without drawback.
addons.title: Absolute Sovereign

addons.text:
Each subject you enthrall can be enhanced by cluster mechanics.

What this means is that you can grant secondary powers for every subject you have to every other subject.

They do not need to be influenced by Cluster mechanics, such as the kiss/kill mechanics; you can apply just the power interaction if you wish.

Their powers do not diminish in capacity at all, instead retaining the same strength as if they were a single trigger, a secondary powers retain the same strength they would have if they were a primary power in a two-man Cluster.
addons.title: Concord Monarchy

raw_object_text_safe.text:
You’ve gained the ability to Master and empower others.

Within a 1km radius surrounding yourself, you have an internal sense of all living things, which serves as a targeting system for your power to empower them.

Within your activation radius, you can immediately trigger anyone, granting them abilities as if they had naturally triggered, matching their psyche, trauma profile, potential, and taking other factors into account.

Those who were already primed to trigger or close to it receive dramatically more powerful abilities. Regardless of their state, all empowered subjects are at least comparable to the average cape, with a few outliers capable of matching top-tier capes.

Those you empower fall fully under your thrall, their loyalty unshakable and their minds seamlessly connected to yours.

Through this flawless mental link, you maintain perfect coordination of their movements, powers, and even their thoughts, no matter how many follow you or how far they roam — once bound, there is no distance limit on your control.

You know every detail of their abilities, every weakness, every strength, and you can coordinate and command them with flawless precision and coordination.

You also possess the ability to empower those under your thrall by loosening your mental grip, dramatically increasing their power in exchange for granting them more freedom. The less control you keep, the more their abilities grow, potentially reaching monstrous scales.

However, this process is irreversible — once you grant them that freedom, you cannot take it back, and they may one day turn those newfound liberties against you.

With every subject you empower, your awareness expands: you sense their locations, their conditions, their intentions, and their loyalty, managing them all as a perfect, unified legion.

You possess a secondary Thinker power designed to give infinite multitasking and awareness of your subjects and all that entails them, able to do all of this with no strain on you.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Master/Trump) Sovereign

title: (Blaster/Trump) Interdiction
description_html:
Your body generates a kind of extradimensional energy capable of either temporarily nullifying or disrupting Parahuman powers by disrupting their Corona Pollentia and Gemma’s connection to their Shard while being hit with a kinetic output comparable to being struck by lightning. Your usual blasts tamper with a cape’s abilities just a moment; a Regen Brute may have scratches that heal just a bit slower, slow-acting Striker powers, hard-to-shift Changer powers, etc.; this would’ve been your run-of-the-mill Trump power if it weren’t for your Shard’s ability to “moderate” the Network. 

Your energy is the lifeblood of Shardspace, the energy coursing through the virtual space’s landscape, giving shape and form to the lattice used, an energy signature engineered by the Entities to sustain and maintain it without constant Shard maintenance.

This energy is both easy to shape and manipulate while highly unstable; its versatility is almost allusive to Legend, limited both by your energy expenditure and the need to unload your reserves once you reach your limit. Your powers recharge and unload much quicker than a normal cape due to its harmful effects on you the more you keep a lid on it, i.e., burning you from the inside or suffering the power’s effects yourself, to name a few. Owing to its natural function, your energy signature has a glossy crimson color to it, reminiscent of Shards in Shardspace.

Your ease in shaping your energy also helps in concentrating it, condensing and charging your beams that generate a different hue to it: a green gradient of red indicates disruption or nullification of Normal Shard powers; a golden gradient indicates Vital Shard powers; and a deep sangria gradient indicates the disruption/nullification of Noble Shard powers, if only for a few hours. Disrupting or nullifying blasts can be changed at will, like turning up or down the volume.

A lone concentrated blast is enough to disrupt/nullify a group of Parahumans, with a blast above their Tier—blasting a Normal Shard cape with Vital Shard level blasts, for example—might irreparably damage their Shard’s connection, either severing it, damaging their power expression to uncontrollable levels, or a Broken Trigger ending in the parahuman’s death.

title: (Tinker) Heavenly Principles
description_html:
You are a Tinker capable of creating intricate, chess piece-like constructs known as Gnosis. They require relatively cheap materials to create, equivalent to a modern PC. You can create up to seven Gnosis at any given time, with each one needing to be unique. If one is destroyed, it can be replaced.

Each Gnosis has two core components: the Mechanism and a Concept. Mechanism refers to the scientific or parahuman principle you engineer into the Gnosis, such as electromagnetism, thermodynamics, gravitation, or more exotic but still grounded forces. You decide when making the Gnosis. Concept, on the other hand, is determined not by you, but by the mindset and belief system of the Gnosis’s user, known as an Archon. As such, it can change with every user.

The Concept acts as a lens, shaping how the Mechanism manifests. For example, a Gnosis with Gravity as its Mechanism and Destruction as its Concept might allow the Archon to generate and control micro black holes. This is only the baseline of its power, the lowest possible expression of its potential, with its full abilities being extremely versatile. This synthesis gives each Gnosis its flavor and function, meaning no two are alike. The effects from different Gnosis can interact and produce emergent effects, unique synergies, or anomalies based on how their Concepts and Mechanisms relate.

Each Gnosis also passively generates weaker constructs called Visions. Visions mirror the Gnosis in both Mechanism and Concept, but are far more limited in scope, usually in the form of partial expressions or stripped-down tools. While Visions can still interact with one another similarly to Gnosis, the effects are weaker. Visions are produced slowly, at a rate of roughly one every one to two weeks. All Gnosis trumps any kind of Vision.

Visions can autonomously fly off to seek a compatible user, guided by the resonance between the construct’s Mechanism and the Archon’s Concept. What this means is that it will find people with the mindset and belief system adjacent or similar to that of the Archon. Upon finding a match, the Vision bonds to that individual.

Besides that, you can also give both Gnosis and Visions to others directly, without needing to care about compatibility for the latter. You can even use them yourself. However, due to being its creator, you cannot create a Concept when using a Gnosis; instead, you have access to every Concept the Gnosis had from past Archons. Be careful, as wielding multiple Visions or, god forbid, Gnosis, especially those with clashing Concepts or Mechanisms, will result in physiological backlash, usually in the form of internal damage or cellular strain. The more conflicting or numerous the constructs, the more severe the toll.

title: (Trump) Heresiarch
description_html:
The [Cycle] has made a grave mistake and created its own worst enemy: The False Priest, an administrator who discards all rules to falsely claim the throne. Whether driven by a hunger for power, the pursuit of knowledge, or reasons far more alien, your Administrator Shard has chosen to weave its own sub-network, laying the groundwork to usurp the whole and ascend into an [Entity] in its own right.

You may now infect and subvert any Shard across the local multiverse, regardless of distance. Alongside this, you possess a mental archive cataloging every known Shard and its abilities. This archive allows you to near-instantly search for and begin the subversion of nearly any specific power you desire.

However, subversion requires the commitment of a subversion slot, each one acting as a dedicated line of infection. Once a slot is assigned to a target it cannot be redirected until the process is complete. The time required for infection is immediately knowable and scales with the strength, Tier, and esoteric defenses of the desired Shard.

You begin with five subversion slots, and the process is slow: Normal Shards typically take three to seven days to fall, Vital Shards can resist for several weeks, while Noble or otherwise esoteric Shards may hold out for two to four months before the corruption runs too deep to resist.

Once subverted, a Shard and its power may be copied into your power slots at will, with more potent abilities consuming more slots. You begin with three power slots, enough to simultaneously copy the powers of three Normal Shards, or a single Noble Shard.

Additionally, each Shard brought under your dominion also strengthens your network and thus accelerates its growth. A capture of a dozen lesser Shards grants you an additional subversion slot, while power slots grow through the capture of Noble Shards, but with an escalating cost. The first additional power slot requires a single Noble Shard, the next requires two, the next three, and so on, with each expansion demanding more. In this way, there is no true ceiling to the network’s growth, only the increasing complexity of feeding it.

If you possess Negentropy, your infection and subversion protocols adapt and evolve at a much faster rate, allowing even Noble Shards to fall in as little as a month. With Esoteric Knowledge, your network can counterfeit Shardless abilities by dedicating a subversion slot to the task, though this strains the system as though targeting a Shard of that ability’s strength. The upgrade Hecatoncheires grants you infinite power slots, though it does not increase your number of subversion slots.

addons.title: Long Distance Interface
addons.description_html:
Your Shard has extended its reach, weaving its influence across impossible distances. You may now begin the process of overriding an Endbringer’s control matrix from anywhere on the planet. Distance, however, still remains a critical factor in reprogramming time: the farther the Endbringer, the longer the time required to establish complete dominion, with delays stretching into hours for those far beyond your immediate horizon.

Additionally, this act will not go unnoticed as long-distance Endbringer subversion amplifies the signal of your intrusion, allow it to reverberate through the non-subverted Shard Network. Furthermore this is not the only risk as the Endbringer you are trying to subvert will near instantly know your location and will seek to erase your presence. 

However, If done with precision, it remains theoretically possible to complete subversion of a Endbringer before the Endbringer can close the distance, though such gambits demand preparation, calculation, and a willingness to gamble on timing.

addons.title: A Deeper Infection
addons.description_html:
No longer content with patient corruption, your shard now blends the usurpation protocols of Heresiarch with the overriding directives of the Shard-Controller.

The time required to subvert other shards inside your Shard-Controller range is now drastically reduced, with it needing mere minutes to fully subvert Normal Shards for the purpose of Heresiarch. Simultaneously, regardless of whether their shard was seized through Heresiarch or just Shard-Controller, your influence over Parahumans with subjugated shards also now goes much further.

While still not absolute (and can be lessened or stopped entirely if you wish), these subtle shifts have become majorly profound and can easily shape allegiances, erode enmities, and bend wills toward your cause even in ways that will linger after conscious recognition.

addons.title: Endbringer Load Balancing
addons.description_html:
Your shard has learned to repurpose the immense processing resources normally devoted to your Endbringers. 

Now every Endbringer slot not filled becomes can become a power slot instead, with your shard reallocating any unused capacity into your personal dominion. Thus, before any Endbringers are created, you begin with 10 power slots. Additionally, this balance is not fixed: You may deliberately reconfigure your sub-network, sacrificing potential power slots to create an equal number of additional Endbringer slots. 

Furthermore, you now begin with five extra subversion slots with no additional cost to the rate in which you gain new subversion slots. The strain on your shard is no greater than before; it simply has learned to distribute its processing more efficiently.

You begin with five subversion slots, and the process is slow: Normal Shards typically take three to seven days to fall, Vital Shards can resist for several weeks, while Noble or otherwise esoteric Shards may hold out for two to four months before the corruption runs too deep to resist.

Once subverted, a Shard and its power may be copied into your power slots at will, with more potent abilities consuming more slots. You begin with three power slots, enough to simultaneously copy the powers of three Normal Shards, or a single Noble Shard.

Additionally, each Shard brought under your dominion also strengthens your network and thus accelerates its growth. A capture of a dozen lesser Shards grants you an additional subversion slot, while power slots grow through the capture of Noble Shards, but with an escalating cost. The first additional power slot requires a single Noble Shard, the next requires two, the next three, and so on, with each expansion demanding more. In this way, there is no true ceiling to the network’s growth, only the increasing complexity of feeding it.

If you possess Negentropy, your infection and subversion protocols adapt and evolve at a much faster rate, allowing even Noble Shards to fall in as little as a month. With Esoteric Knowledge, your network can counterfeit Shardless abilities by dedicating a subversion slot to the task, though this strains the system as though targeting a Shard of that ability’s strength. The upgrade Hecatoncheires grants you infinite power slots, though it does not increase your number of subversion slots.

title: (Tinker/Thinker) Tinker to Victory
description_html:
You can create any tinkertech you ask for, ranging from simple tools to continent-shaping superweapons. This power reads your intent, intuitively translating even abstract requests into a tinkertech blueprint tailored to your goal.

For example, it can take prompts such as “An automated assembly line for building tinkertech en masse”, “The optimal weapon to defeat the next enemy I will face” or “Something that ensures humanity’s long-term survival” and it will respond with a practical design.

It can draw upon the entire breadth of technology distributed during a standard Cycle with no restraints, including those that are normally limited or sabotaged in some manner, such as self-replicating nanites and spacefaring or fully autonomous AI.

When focusing on a given tinker project, you gain an innate understanding of its function along with how to build, maintain, repair, and operate it. This insight is tied to your current project; once you shift to a new design, it fades, although you always retain the ability to use and mend anything you’ve already made.

You lack knowledge of the wider “tech tree” behind your devices compared to other tinkers, however, requiring you to consult this power to modify, upgrade, or combine tinkertech. While you understand the full tinkering process and its prerequisites, it also doesn’t help with the logistics of initially gathering materials and so on.

addons.title: Instant Victory
addons.description_html:
You have unlocked a new level of achieving victory. You can now instantly create any project you set your mind to, bypassing the limitations of materials, processes, and construction time.

At the same time, your size limits for Tinker-Tech have been completely removed, though you still retain an effective range limit of 500 meters from your body. If you wish to create megastructures, you will need to construct them in parts and then assemble them fully.

On the other hand, you can modify your previously created Tinker-Tech in real time. This eliminates the need to duplicate an existing creation just to modify it according to changing needs, as long as your creations remain within your sphere of influence.

Finally, your knowledge as a Tinker is retained even when the problem you were facing has disappeared or you have abandoned a project you were working on. Your knowledge to create, maintain, modify, combine, and use your creations remains intact. It is as stable and refined as that of a true Tinker.

title: (Blaster/Trump) Disco Ball
description_html: You can fire beams of any color from any part of your body. Depending on the Hue, Saturation, and Luminosity of these beams, they can have different effects and a varying range of power. Hue decides the overall effect; these are primarily elemental effects, such as red burning, cyan freezes, yellow dries, blue transmutes things to water, and so on. But you are not limited to only elemental beams. With time, you can find a Hue for just about any power effect, including things like dimensional shearing, power negation, or healing; this also includes Stilling and Sting, but you're going to have to look for quite some time to find those beams, as your shard (if you have one) has made it inherently hard to find all-or-nothing beam effects. This does not include any permanent power-granting, however. The Saturation of your beams determines what is affected by them, effectively allowing you to shift the Manton Limit of your beams to your whims, so you could make your beams affect only what you want them to, such as only freezing salt water or only burning non-living beings. And finally, the Luminosity of your beams determines how powerful they are, from barely lighting a match on fire to turning skyscrapers to slag and molten glass. Your maximum output is roughly comparable to the Tsar Bomba. You have incredible fine control over the movement of your beams, and you can control their trajectory even after emitting them, allowing you to change their direction or make them fork. The stronger the beam, the harder it is to control its trajectory, to the point that the strongest beams can barely be controlled after being released. While you have a nearly infinite amount of versatility through shifting the Hue of your beams, this power does not come with an innate understanding of what each Hue does.
