title: (Breaker/Trump) Herald of the End
description_html: You can transform into Breaker states corresponding to any Endbringers that have been activated in the Cycle. You start with forms corresponding to Simurgh, Behemoth, and Leviathan, even if they are not activated, and you gain additional Breaker forms as new Endbringers are activated. These forms are half as big with a corresponding halving of the physical attributes as their true Endbringer counterpart but have all their abilities in some form, albeit having vastly reduced range, as your Endbringer abilities only have a range of 3.5 city blocks at most. While you are in one of your Breaker forms, you lose your human senses but gain the Shard Feedback universal upgrade to compensate for this loss of perception. If the Endbringer is deactivated or dies at the hands of anyone but you, you will lose the corresponding Breaker form. But if you kill the Endbringer while you are in the corresponding Breaker form, you absorb the fallen Endbringer's power and take its full might for yourself, without shackling yourself to its directives. You cannot lose the last remaining Breaker form, preventing you from losing all your power, though your versatility would drop heavily.

addons.title: Death is not the only End
addons.description_html: Your ability to control Endbringers has fused with your ability to copy the power of Endbringers. Now any Endbringers under your control now counts as if you have killed that Endbringer for that Endbringer’s corresponding breaker form. As such, you now gain the full power of any Endbringer under your control when you use its corresponding breaker form. However, if an Endbringer is not fully grown then you only get access to the abilities it currently has.

addons.title: Herald of Hypothetical Endbringers
addons.description_html:
Your ability to create Endbringers has synchronized with your ability to copy the powers of Endbringers. Now you gain 1 additional breaker form for every possible endbringer you can make with Endbringer Engine. These additional breaker forms will forever be stuck at their reduced capabilities and powers but can mirror any possible Endbringer you can make. Furthermore, the time to change the information in a possible Endbringer’s breaker form is 1/7th the time it would take you to make an Endbringer with Endbringer Engine.

By default, this means you start with 7 empty hypothetical Endbringer breaker forms with each taking 4 days (1 day with Negentropy) to fill with the reduced abilities of any possible Endbringer.

title: (Blaster/Shaker) Buster
description_html: "Nothin' but gas." Your Blaster power is rather simple, being that you can release beams comprised of a mix of kinetic and regular light. You can also both 'polarize' and change the wavelength of the kinetic energy and light such that they don't scatter, preventing innocents from being blinded or your beams turning into bombs. But that's all pretty bog-standard for a Blaster power. No, where your power truly shines is the sheer magnitude at which it can operate. Your blasts make Legend look like he wields a squirt gun and can even surpass Scion in pure firepower (at least by a little). Your maximum energy output is sufficient to raze cities and sink islands in an instant, and you could level a country during tea time. You could overpower Behemoth's dynakinesis with nothing but raw firepower, though the surrounding country may not appreciate it. You are able to shape your blasts and beams as they leave you, but you have no control over them after. You also have a Breaker power that prevents your attacks from harming you and a Mover power that lets you both suspend and slow yourself midair. For actual flight, you are able to allow some kickback from your attacks to propel you, similar to a certain distressed damsel. Due to the nature of your shard, you are much more likely to run out of juice mid-Cycle, and unless you have Negentropy, you may notice some weakening similar to Eidolon after a few decades. Unlike him, you shard can 'recharge' itself with idle time, similar to Purity.

addons.title: Rodger! Removing That Direction
addons.description_html:
Whereas before, the power of your blasts was considered massive, now they far surpass what could be considered absurd.

The sheer energy density of your blasts is sufficient to warp space-time in their vicinity, allowing them to kill capes such as Grey Boy or Alabaster and harm Brutes who have esoteric defenses such as Alexandria.

Moreover, this addon comes with a technique. By condensing a beam into a subatomic line, you can achieve energy densities similar in principle to a Kugelblitz, forming a 1-dimensional line capable of cutting through anything. This has the same rules as other All-or-Nothing effects, with the exception that your power won't go on cooldown when hitting another, simply stopping the blast instead with no other consequences.

But that's all pretty bog-standard for a Blaster power. No, where your power truly shines is the sheer magnitude at which it can operate. Your blasts make Legend look like he wields a squirt gun and can even surpass Scion in pure firepower (at least by a little). Your maximum energy output is sufficient to raze cities and sink islands in an instant, and you could level a country during tea time. You could overpower Behemoth's dynakinesis with nothing but raw firepower, though the surrounding country may not appreciate it. You are able to shape your blasts and beams as they leave you, but you have no control over them after. You also have a Breaker power that prevents your attacks from harming you and a Mover power that lets you both suspend and slow yourself midair. For actual flight, you are able to allow some kickback from your attacks to propel you, similar to a certain distressed damsel. Due to the nature of your shard, you are much more likely to run out of juice mid-Cycle, and unless you have Negentropy, you may notice some weakening similar to Eidolon after a few decades. Unlike him, you shard can 'recharge' itself with idle time, similar to Purity.
raw_object_text_safe.title: (Blaster/Shaker) Buster

title: (Trump) Iconoclast
description_html: You can permanently copy and internalize abilities by interacting with sources or representations of power. Your ability can replicate the powers and skills of Parahumans, be used on items such as Cauldron vials or the Garden of Eden, and can also be applied to Tinkertech or even mundane objects like smartphones or even normal living things, such as animals or normal humans. Upon interacting with a viable target, your power pings and creates an internal conceptual blueprint of what it can do, feeding that understanding directly to you. From there, you may choose whether or not to internalize your own version. You may internalize the full capabilities of a target — such as a Parahuman’s power, skills, and experience, or all the functions of a smartphone or Tinkertech — or take only specific aspects. For example, you could copy only a Parahuman’s power while ignoring their skills. Regardless of what you replicate, your ability internalizes and perfectly adapts it for your own use. Replicating a smartphone would grant you a power with all the same functions. Once internalized, the power is fully yours and perfectly adapted. You are not drawing on the original source, but instead possess an internal version. This removes inherent drawbacks, incompatibilities, external dependencies, and similar baggage. Powers that relied on external energy sources are generated internally. Psychological or physical damage tied to abilities (such as Burnscar’s) is removed, and you do not inherit weaknesses tied to the original source. You may freely ping any number of potential sources, gaining an intuitive preview of what powers they would provide and how those abilities would behave for you, without committing to a slot. Actually internalizing a new power — generating it into an empty slot — may only be done once per month. You possess nine total power slots, and any replicated power occupies a single slot. You may activate or deactivate any stored power at will, retaining full control over all replicated abilities, including the ability to suppress or disable them entirely. You may drop a power instantly, freeing its slot. That slot may be refilled immediately provided you have not already internalized another power within the current month; otherwise, it remains inert until your monthly internalization refreshes. You may also shave off parts of an ability if desired. You may also transfer any internalized power to another person, permanently granting them that ability. This empties the corresponding slot. Slots emptied this way follow the same rules as voluntary removal. A major strength of this ability lies in its interaction with representations. Rather than requiring direct access to the original source, you may replicate abilities from items or symbolic stand-ins that meaningfully represent something else. This includes supernatural, magical, or superhuman abilities derived from items, symbols, artifacts, depictions, or totems connected to another being or concept. This can range from action figures and video game discs to pictures, drawings, stylized depictions, or other similar proxies. Your ability interprets the representation, constructs the intended power, and offers that version to you for internalization. The representation must be sufficiently connected to what it symbolizes, but need not be original or unique. Note that since this is a shard power, it’s an Entity’s closest construction of the ability and not necessarily a genuine replication. Possessing Esoteric Knowledge or being Shardless removes that restriction. All functions of this power may be used freely, except for internalizing abilities, which can only be done once per month. Negentropy/Shardless increases your slots to twelve and reduces your cooldown to one week.
